jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Description**

**Real Estate, Planning, Design & Construction**

UCLA Health is one of the most advanced academic medical systems in the world, and the environments we build are as critical to our mission as the care delivered within them. We are seeking a Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment Project Coordinator to join our Real Estate, Planning, Design & Construction team, a professional who brings technical fluency in design and construction with the organizational discipline to drive projects from concept through closeout in one of healthcare's most complex and regulated environments.

In this role, you will independently manage small capital projects end-to-end while supporting Senior Project Managers with furniture and equipment on priority initiatives exceeding $1M. You will serve as a key liaison between contracted vendors, consultants, and UCLA Health clients, coordinating design, construction, FF&E procurement, regulatory compliance, and move planning across a dynamic portfolio of concurrent projects.

**In this role, you will:**

* Maintain and develop the PDC Resource Library, manage vendor relationships, vet new products, and support the department's Standardization Program
* Manage the full FF&E program, coordinating with clients, vendors, and manufacturers through procurement, delivery, installation, and punch list resolution
* Lead small capital projects through all phases, from scoping and design through plan check, bidding, construction, and fit-up/move-in, with full ownership of budgets, schedules, and client communication
* Navigate plan check and back-check processes through Campus Building Official and HCAI (OSHPD) approval, and manage all associated documentation and inspector visits
* Oversee construction activities including contractor schedules, pay applications, and utility and fire alarm shutdowns to maintain an operational facility
* Ensure all project closeout documentation, including warranties, record drawings, and O&M manuals, meets contract requirements and is transferred to the appropriate entity

**Salary Range:** $38.65 – $80.70 per hour.

**Target Salary Range: $39.00 - $45.00 per hour**

  
Pay range: $38.65 - $80.70 an hour  
  
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 1 to 2 years of professional experience in design, construction, or FF&E
* Working knowledge of healthcare construction regulations including HCAI (OSHPD), California Building Code, Title 22, and ADA/accessibility standards
* Strong ability to manage multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities and deadlines
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with clinical, administrative, and vendor stakeholders

**Preferred**

* Experience managing projects within a healthcare or academic medical center environment
* Familiarity with UCLA standards, UCOP Capital Programs processes, and Job Order Contracting
* Experience with FF&E procurement and move coordination in a large institutional setting
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and/or Revit, and intermediate skills in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project) and Bluebeam

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Description**

The Department of Medicine, Division of Pulmonary Medicine is seeking a Program Coordinator to support and oversee operational, programmatic, and research activities for the expansion of the 3 Wishes Program beyond UCLA. This interdisciplinary initiative enhances end-of-life care by fulfilling meaningful wishes for patients and their families, supporting bereavement services, and partnering with clinical teams to promote compassionate, humanistic care. The Program Coordinator will coordinate program operations, communications, outreach, and strategic initiatives that further the program's mission.

Hourly range: $30.63-$59.19

  
Pay range: $30.63 - $59.19 an hour  
  
**Qualifications**  
Required:

* Bachelor’s degree in related field and or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 2-4 years of relevant experience.
* Ability to work independently and also have interpersonal skills to work with teams.
* Demonstrated writing skills to produce wide range of documents and deliverables.
* Experience communicating effectively and professionally and working with a variety of internal and external partners, including UCLA administrators, outside funders, policy makers and community representatives.
* Working knowledge of evaluation, creating datasets, grant writing and proposal submission.
* Strong organizational skills to successfully work on and track complex programs involving short deadlines and multiple tasks, in coordination with multiple teams to achieve program/project mission and goals.
* Working knowledge of program/project development, evaluation, creating datasets, financial management and reporting, research principles including CITI training, grant writing and proposal submission, University procedures and policies, program/project related federal and state regulations.
* Ability to seek out and learn new policies, procedures, and software to advance the mission of the program/project.
* Ability to train new program/project managers and other staff within and external to the unit.

jobs.title: Agency Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Konnect:**

Konnect Agency is an independent PR and communications agency helping brands build awareness, relevance, and momentum. Our work brings together earned media, creator partnerships, experiential marketing, social media, and compelling storytelling.

**The Opportunity:**

We're looking for a strong writer and highly organized Agency Marketing Coordinator to help bring Konnect's work, people, and perspective to a broader audience.

You'll connect the dots across our social channels, newsletter, website, award submissions, and marketing materials, making sure great work becomes compelling content and reaches the right audience.

Working with agency leadership and teams across the business, you'll gather stories, write copy, coordinate assets and approvals, and keep our marketing calendar moving. You should enjoy both finding the story and doing the follow-up needed to get it published.

**What You'll Do:**

**Write and develop content**

* Work with the social and digital teams to gather and help edit social posts, newsletters, website copy, agency announcements, case studies, and marketing materials.
* Turn campaign results, team insights, and agency milestones into clear, engaging stories.
* Support executive thought leadership by developing draft posts and articles from leadership's ideas.
* Adapt stories for different audiences and channels while maintaining a consistent Konnect voice.
* Check facts, results, names, and details before content goes live.

**Connect social, email, and website marketing**

* Maintain one editorial calendar across Konnect's marketing channels.
* Coordinate with social and creative colleagues to develop, approve, and publish content.
* Help produce the agency newsletter, including story selection, copywriting, asset collection, testing, and distribution.
* Keep website news, case studies, and team information current.
* Extend the life of strong content: turn a campaign success into a case study, newsletter feature, social series, and award opportunity.

**Coordinate awards and industry visibility**

* Research relevant agency, campaign, and leadership awards.
* Maintain a calendar of deadlines, requirements, entry fees, and submission status.
* Draft award entries and collect supporting results, visuals, and information from account teams.
* Coordinate reviews and approvals so submissions are accurate and on time.
* Help identify speaking opportunities, agency profiles, and other ways to showcase Konnect's expertise.

**General agency needs**

* Proactively gather campaign wins, coverage, photos, videos, and results from teams.
* Maintain an organized collection of approved marketing assets.
* Set clear internal deadlines, follow up on missing information, and flag obstacles early.
* Support updates to agency credentials, capabilities materials, and case study libraries.
* Track content performance, newsletter engagement, website traffic, and relevant inquiries; recommend practical improvements.

**What you'll bring**

* Approximately 3 years of relevant experience in marketing, communications, PR, journalism, or content.
* Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with samples that demonstrate your ability to tell a clear story.
* Strong organization and the ability to manage several deadlines at once.
* Confidence following up with colleagues at every level and moving work through approvals.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn, Instagram, email marketing platforms, and content scheduling tools.
* Comfort using Canva and collaborating with designers on graphics and simple video content.
* Initiative, curiosity, and sound judgment about what makes a story interesting.
* Comfort using AI tools to support your work, paired with strong editorial judgment and careful fact-checking.

This is a hybrid in-office role with 3 days/week in one of Konnect's hubs (Los Angeles, Chicago). Previous Agency experience in a commensurate role and award submission experience is preferred. As part of the consideration process, applicants will be asked to submit 2-3 writing samples; ideally including social copy, a newsletter, case study, article, or award entry.

Konnect Agency is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.description:
**ACCOUNT COORDINATOR (PART-TIME, NIGHTTIME)**

**We Realize Potential in** ***Your*** **Story**  
  
We are a multi-platform production company, social media agency, and digital media network who are currently on a quest to find a part-time **Account Coordinator** to join our Social Video Services team - Is this your next opportunity?

The Account Coordinator will be responsible for optimizing video content for YouTube and social platforms across a range of verticals, specifically for nighttime shifts.

* **Schedule:** Two days per week, with opportunities to pick up additional shifts as needed. Shifts may include weekends, weekdays, or holidays.
* **Shift Hours:** 3pm–12am.

The day-to-day role will include video optimization, simple analytical report generation, graphic design, copywriting, YouTube channel maintenance, content logging, channel uploads and other general support to the Social Video Services team.

**HOW YOU WILL SPEND YOUR TIME**

* Helping to build and maintain YouTube channels: Optimizing video assets by creating elevated thumbnails using Photoshop or Affinity (depending on the account), well-written titles/descriptions, utilizing all YouTube products, contributing with creative ideation and uploading to a schedule agreed upon with the social video services team
* Growing a YouTube and/or social video audience, and understanding the types of content that keeps them engaged
* Managing community features on YouTube, including creation of images, GIFs and social posts
* Writing copy for posts on YouTube, understanding the importance of editorial voice and tone
* Using YouTube analytics to help inform strategic channel decisions
* Managing a materials library, following existing edit processes and naming conventions
* Emailing with clients, showing prompt communication and professionalism

**WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED**

Skills matter, experience is useful, attitude is everything.

* Bachelor's Degree.
* Excellent knowledge of YouTube and social media platforms and an interest in the differences between them
* A basic understanding of YouTube and social media analytics
* Good working knowledge of Photoshop to create YouTube thumbnails
* Excellent knowledge of different videos formats, video compression, sound/video synchronisation
* Some knowledge of the YouTube and Facebook content management system and other video platforms (bonus)
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to proof-check your own work
* Team player with a hard-working flexible attitude, a good sense of humour and an interest in working in a dynamic start-up environment
* Proficiency in other languages (bonus)

Candidates must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.

**USE OF AI IN APPLICATIONS**

Please keep it human; we want to get to know **you -** your thinking, and your originality. Whilst generative AI tools can be helpful for text refinement, we require your application to jobs at Little Dot Studios to be in your own voice and words. AI cannot be used to generate your responses and any applications appearing to be entirely AI-generated will not be progressed.

jobs.title: Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About IW Group**

IW Group is the leading multicultural advertising and marketing agency with offices in Los Angeles, San Francisco, and New York. Named **Ad Age’s 2025 Multicultural Agency of the Year** and recognized by **PRWeek** for Best in Multicultural Marketing, IW Group produces culture-shaping campaigns for global and national brands.

IW Group drives impactful work by blending storytelling, cultural insight, and innovation to achieve measurable results. We represent multiple brands and deliver distinctive multicultural and cross-generational campaigns.

**The Role**

We’re seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Post Production Coordinator to join our Production team. Working closely with the Post Production Producer, you’ll support all facets of post production across multiple clients—from editorial and finishing to versioning, translation, trafficking, and final delivery.

You’ll help keep projects moving, assets organized, and teams aligned so every deliverable reaches the right destination, on time and to specification. This role is ideal for someone early in their career who thrives in a fast-paced creative environment and wants to deepen their understanding of agency post production and multicultural content.

**What You’ll Do**

* Support the Post Production Producer with project schedules, status updates, production documentation, and day-to-day coordination across multiple client projects.
* Coordinate voiceover recording sessions with talent agencies, recording studios, voiceover talent, language coaches, and internal teams, including scheduling, session logistics, and follow-up on audio deliverables.
* Assist with SAG-AFTRA talent and non-union talent administration, including talent contract requests, talent estimate request forms, session reports, completion reports, and related documentation.
* Maintain accurate talent records and assist with tracking usage terms, expiration dates, renewals, and associated talent costs.
* Support production budgeting and administration, including vendor estimates, talent estimates, purchase orders (POs), invoices, and project expense tracking.
* Coordinate with editors, motion designers, audio teams, and external post-production vendors to track assets, revisions, schedules, and finishing milestones.
* Maintain deliverable matrices and version trackers covering different formats, cutdowns, languages, graphics, legal copy, and platform requirements.
* Coordinate translation and localization workflows with language partners and internal reviewers, including scripts, voiceover, subtitles, captions, and on-screen text; track approvals and implementation.
* Organize review links, consolidate feedback, and track creative, client, and legal approvals to ensure teams are working from the correct versions.
* Support quality control (QC) by reviewing picture, sound, runtimes, captions, graphics, spelling, approved copy, file naming, and technical specifications; flag discrepancies for resolution.
* Assist trafficking and final delivery of approved assets to media partners, broadcasters, digital platforms, and client teams, ensuring deadlines and delivery requirements are met.
* Provide basic hands-on editing and asset preparation support as needed, including simple cuts, revisions, resizing, and formatting for various platforms.
* Maintain organized project folders, source files, final masters, production documentation, and archives to support efficient workflows and project closeout.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Education and Experience**

* 1–3 years of relevant experience in post production, production coordination, or creative project support; internships and equivalent hands-on experience will be considered.
* A degree in film, media, communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Basic understanding of editorial, graphics, color, audio, finishing, and delivery workflows.

**Skills and Abilities**

* Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to track multiple projects, versions, and deadlines.
* Clear written and verbal communication and a collaborative approach to working with creative teams, account teams, and vendors.
* Comfort using spreadsheets, project trackers, review platforms, and shared asset systems.
* Familiarity with video formats, codecs, resolutions, aspect ratios, frame rates, captions, and file naming conventions.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for transcription, captioning, translation, audio cleanup, and other post production tasks, with careful review for accuracy and quality.
* Ability to follow specifications, identify discrepancies, and flag questions or scheduling risks promptly.
* A proactive, dependable approach and willingness to learn new tools and workflows.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and deliverables simultaneously.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to working with producers, account teams, creative teams, talent agencies, recording studios, and vendors.
* Experience supporting production or post-production workflows, including scheduling, tracking deliverables, maintaining project documentation, and coordinating with internal and external partners.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, production trackers, project management tools, and shared asset systems.
* Ability to assist with production administration, including talent paperwork, contracts, estimates, purchase orders (POs), session reports, and completion reports.
* Basic understanding of voiceover recording, talent coordination, and post-production workflows.
* Working knowledge of video editing software, such as Adobe Premiere Pro, with the ability to assist with basic editing tasks, revisions, and asset preparation when needed.
* Basic familiarity with video and audio formats, file specifications, naming conventions, and digital delive

jobs.title: DVC Communications Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

**About the Role & Team**

As part of the Sales Operations Team at Disney Vacation Club, the Communications Coordinator supports communication, engagement, and recognition initiatives that drive awareness, connection, and business results across the organization. This position partners closely with Disney Vacation Club, Disney Parks and Resorts, Marketing, Compliance and other internal stakeholders to ensure clear communication, seamless integration and alignment on priorities across the business.

You will report to DVC Sales Communication & Integration Manager.

This is a Full-Time role based in Anaheim, CA.

**What You Will Do**

* Develop and execute communication plans that support organizational initiatives, Sales programs, employee engagement efforts and business priorities.
* Create and distribute written communications, presentations, visual materials and other branded content for internal audiences.
* Partner with global leaders and stakeholders across multiple time zones to gather information, align messaging and support communication needs.
* Coordinate projects from concept through execution, managing timelines, deliverables, approvals, stakeholder communications and implementation plans.
* Support employee engagement, recognition, and culture-building initiatives through strategic communication planning and execution.
* Plan and execute events, meetings, celebrations, recognition programs, and engagement activities, including logistics, scheduling, communications and day-of event support.
* Support video production initiatives, including coordinating filming schedules, operating camera and audio equipment, capturing footage, and editing video content.
* Collaborate with the Production team on video projects, including pre-production planning, filming coordination, footage transfer and post-production support.
* Collaborate with internal partners to develop experiences and programs that enhance Cast engagement, recognition and organizational culture.
* Monitor communication and engagement effectiveness, identify opportunities for improvement and recommend solutions that support business objectives.
* Maintain communication platforms, content repositories and engagement resources to ensure information remains accurate and accessible.
* Support additional Sales Operations initiatives, special projects and business priorities as assigned.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in communications, internal communications, public relations, marketing or a related field with demonstrated project coordination experience
* Experience developing and executing communication plans for internal audiences
* Experience creating branded communication materials, presentations and visual assets
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners and stakeholders
* Strong project management, relationship management and problem-solving skills.
* Strong knowledge of AP Style, grammar, punctuation and proofreading standards
* Experience utilizing communication and collaboration platforms such as SharePoint, Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva or similar tools
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Teams, Word, PowerPoint and Excel
* Hands-on experience with video production, including camera operation, audio recording, lighting and filming techniques.
* Schedule availability to include weekends, variable shifts and holidays
* Trusted to maintain confidential information

**Preferred Qualifications & Skills**

* Background in supporting employee engagement, recognition or culture-building initiatives
* Demonstrated ability to develop communication campaigns that drive awareness, participation and engagement
* Experience supporting executive-level communications, presentations or leadership messaging
* Background in supporting video production projects from pre-production planning through post-production and final delivery.
* Skills in updating and maintaining digital content through content management systems and web publishing platforms
* Proven ability to plan and execute events from conception through completion, including logistics, scheduling, stakeholder communications and on-site event support
* Experience coordinating cross-functional projects involving multiple stakeholders and business partners

**Education**

* High School Diploma or Equivalent
* Bachelor’s Degree in Communications and/or Marketing or related field preferred

**Additional Information**

Disney offers a rewards package to help you live your best life. This includes health and savings benefits, educational opportunities, and special extras that only Disney can provide. Learn more about our benefits and perks at https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits.

Select benefits may be provided as part of the compensation package, such as medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. jobs.title: Office Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Forte Tools is a Southern California-based manufacturer and wholesaler of tools and equipment, serving retailers, dealers, and distributors across the United States. Our team brings decades of experience in the concrete industry, with a focus on product quality and reliability.

We are seeking an organized and detail-oriented Office Operations Coordinator to support customer order processing, QuickBooks invoicing, shipping coordination, and general office administration. This role works closely with customers, vendors, warehouse staff, and freight providers to ensure accurate orders, timely deliveries, and well-maintained records.

**Responsibilities**

* Process customer orders accurately and efficiently.
* Prepare and issue customer invoices using QuickBooks.
* Coordinate with warehouse staff on inventory availability, order preparation, and shipments.
* Arrange freight shipments, track deliveries, and follow up on shipping updates.
* Communicate with customers, vendors, freight providers, and internal team members regarding orders and operational matters.
* Maintain accurate and organized records of orders, invoices, shipping documents, and customer information.
* Follow up on pending orders, shipments, and customer requests.
* Assist with purchasing, scheduling, and general administrative tasks.
* Support daily office workflows and operational coordination.

**Requirements**

* At least 2 years of relevant work experience, preferably in office administration, order processing, logistics, customer service, or warehouse coordination.
* Fluency in spoken and written English is required. Bilingual English/Chinese skills are strongly preferred; Cantonese proficiency is a plus.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize responsibilities, and follow through on pending orders and requests.
* Effective communication and coordination skills when working with customers, vendors, warehouse staff, and internal teams.

Pay: $24.00 - $35.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator - ARCH
jobs.description:

**Essential Functions:**

* Provide administrative and operational support to assigned leadership, ensuring efficient day-to-day workflow.

* Coordinate meetings, appointments, and events; prepare materials and document meeting outcomes as needed.

* Manage incoming communications, including calls and emails; prioritize and route inquiries appropriately.

* Prepare, review, and format correspondence, reports, presentations, and other business documents.

* Maintain organized filing systems and records, ensuring accuracy and accessibility of information.

* Track action items, deadlines, and deliverables; follow up to ensure timely completion.

* Coordinate travel arrangements and process expense reports in accordance with organizational policies.

* Support cross-functional coordination and communication across departments and stakeholders.

* Assist with special projects, initiatives, and administrative processes as assigned.

* Handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism

* Perform all other related duties as assigned.

  

**Communication/Interpersonal:**

* Practical oral and written communication skills are appropriate to the audience's needs.

* Ability to develop and deliver effective presentations live via online or virtual mediums.

* Excellent collaboration and team-building skills.

* Practical conflict management skills.

* Ability to effectively build relationships with customers and executive management.

**Decision Making/Organizational Skills:**

* Demonstrate a high level of accuracy, even under pressure.

* Excellent organizational skills.

* Ability to perform work independently with minimal supervision.

* Ability to exercise sound judgment and make decisions based on accurate and timely analysis.

**Productivity:**

* Demonstrated time management and priority-setting skills.

* Ability to simultaneously handle multiple priorities.

* Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

* Ability to prioritize responsibilities and organize workload to ensure that timeframes are met and the work is completed within deadlines.

* Ability to define, develop, and analyze performance measures and metrics; exercise sound judgment and make decisions based on accurate and timely analysis.

* Must be able to frequently move about inside the facility to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.

* Occasionally: 11-25 pounds.

* Frequently: 1-10 pounds.

* Must succinctly communicate information and ideas so that others will understand the information accurately.

We offer competitive pay, opportunities for growth, and a variety of benefits and resources designed to support your well-being, financial future, and professional development. Benefit eligibility varies by position, employment type, and plan requirements.

* Medical, dental, and vision plans

We are also building a comprehensive operating system focused on data and workflows that span across systems, processes, people, and care contexts. jobs.title: Procurement Coordinator
jobs.description:
Procurement Coordinator

Osiopack- Anaheim, CA

Job Type: Full-time

**Be the Connection That Keeps Our Supply Chain Moving**

Osiopack is looking for a highly organized, proactive Procurement Coordinator to join our team in Anaheim.

This isn't a position where you'll simply issue purchase orders and update spreadsheets. You'll play an important role in keeping our international supply chain moving, communicating directly with overseas suppliers, monitoring production, coordinating shipments, resolving issues, and helping ensure our customers' orders arrive accurately and on time.

You'll serve as a key liaison between our U.S. team and our overseas manufacturing partners. If you're someone who enjoys staying on top of details, solving problems before they become bigger problems, and keeping multiple moving pieces organized, we'd like to meet you.

**What You'll Do**

As our Procurement Coordinator, you will:

* Communicate regularly with overseas suppliers regarding purchase orders, production schedules, invoices, priorities, and shipments
* Track open purchase orders from placement through production and delivery
* Monitor production status, lead times, and potential schedule risks
* Coordinate expedited orders and help resolve delays before they impact customers
* Obtain quotations and assist with supplier sourcing and purchasing negotiations
* Prepare and maintain purchase orders, RFQs, shipping documentation, supplier correspondence, and internal documentation
* Review supplier proposals, purchase orders, invoices, receipts, and related documents for accuracy
* Coordinate with suppliers to identify the best pricing and delivery options
* Maintain supplier cost information and monitor changes affecting procurement
* Work cross-functionally with Customer Service, Accounting, Production, Receiving, and other departments
* Obtain samples, inspection documentation, certifications, and other supplier information as required
* Coordinate rejected or nonconforming materials with suppliers
* Help identify and resolve purchasing, production, documentation, and logistics issues
* Translate supplier emails, documents, and reports when needed
* Assist with special projects and other procurement-related responsibilities

**What We're Looking For**

Our ideal candidate is:

* Bilingual in English and Korean speaking, reading, and writing **strongly preferred**
* Experienced in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, or a related field
* Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple open orders simultaneously
* Detail-oriented and able to catch documentation or scheduling errors
* A strong communicator who is comfortable working with international suppliers
* Proactive, you don't simply report a problem; you help find the solution
* Comfortable following up persistently when information or action is needed
* Able to prioritize urgent requirements while maintaining accuracy
* Comfortable working across multiple departments
* Proficient with email, Microsoft Word, and Excel
* Familiar with inventory control, forecasting, and supplier lead-time management

**The Person Who Will Succeed Here**

You don't wait until a delivery is late to ask where it is.

You notice when a production date begins slipping, follow up with the supplier, understand what's causing the delay, communicate internally, and help develop a solution.

You understand that successful procurement isn't just about placing orders, it's about communication, follow-through, accuracy, anticipation, and accountability.

**Schedule:**

Monday–Friday

40 hours per week

On-site in Anaheim, California

**Benefits include:**

401(k)

Health insurance

Dental insurance

Vision insurance

Paid time off

**Interested?**

If you have experience coordinating purchasing, suppliers, production, or international logistics and you're looking for a role where your organization and follow-through directly impact the success of the business we'd like to hear from you.

Apply with your resume and tell us briefly about your experience working with suppliers, purchasing, manufacturing, or international supply chains.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $24.50 - $33.75 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

Home to the Los Angeles Chargers and Super Bowl LVI Champion Los Angeles Rams, the 3.1 million-square-foot SoFi Stadium is the NFL’s largest venue, and the first indoor-outdoor stadium. It seats approximately 70,000, expandable to 100,000, with more than 260 luxury suites and over 13,000 premium seats. jobs.title: AI-First Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Elite Open School**

Since 1987, Elite Education Group has trained generations of students and families worldwide to achieve their American education dreams. Elite Open School, founded in Southern California in 2015, provides accredited blended education for middle and high school students in the U.S. and abroad. EOS is accredited by both WASC and Cognia, offering UC-approved courses and College Board-approved APs.

**The Role: Why AI-First?**

This is not a traditional administrative role. We are looking for someone who sees every repetitive task as a problem to solve with AI. Your primary mission is to **reduce complexity, time, cost, and burden** across school operations by identifying, building, and maintaining AI-powered workflows and automations. You will be a part of the administrative foundation of our school and you will help us do it smarter, faster, and more efficiently than before.

We want you to figure out how to leverage the latest AI tools, integrations, and automations so that manual processes become automated pipelines, communication becomes streamlined, and our team can focus on what matters most: our students and their families.

**Core ResponsibilitiesAI Workflow Design & Automation**

* Audit existing administrative processes and identify opportunities for AI automation and augmentation
* Research, evaluate, and implement AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Zapier, Make, Notion AI, Google AI features) to streamline school operations
* Build and maintain automated workflows for enrollment processing, student registration, data entry, withdrawals, and records management
* Design integrations between school systems (SIS, LMS, email, Slack, Google Workspace) to eliminate manual data transfer and reduce errors
* Create AI-assisted templates, auto-responses, and smart routing for common inquiries across email, Slack, and phone
* Document all automations and workflows so they are reproducible, trainable, and scalable

**School Administration (AI-Augmented)**

* Manage student information and data across school systems—using AI to flag inconsistencies, automate updates, and generate reports
* Handle Elite Open School communications—leveraging AI drafting, summarization, and prioritization tools
* Maintain thorough knowledge of EOS services and proactively surface relevant information to team members using AI-powered knowledge bases or internal chatbots
* Support team projects by responding to requests for assistance, using AI to accelerate research, document creation, and task coordination
* Oversee onboarding documentation and internal training materials—keeping them current and accessible, ideally through AI-generated or AI-updated resources
* Provide general administrative and clerical support, continuously seeking ways to automate or semi-automate recurring tasks

**Continuous Improvement & Reporting**

* Track time and cost savings generated by AI implementations and report on ROI to leadership
* Stay current on emerging AI tools, trends, and best practices relevant to education administration and edtech
* Proactively propose new automations and process improvements on a monthly basis
* Train team members on new AI tools and workflows as they are deployed

**Ideal Candidate ProfileMindset & Disposition**

* AI-curious and proactive—you experiment with new tools before being asked to
* Growth mindset with a bias toward action and iteration
* Comfort with ambiguity; you can figure things out without a playbook
* Patience, sincerity, and compassion in student- and family-facing interactions
* Genuine interest in growing within education and/or the edtech industry

**Skills & Capabilities**

* Demonstrated ability to use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar) for real work tasks—not just casual use
* Experience with or willingness to quickly learn workflow automation platforms (Zapier, Make/Integromat, Power Automate, or similar)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong self-organization and attention to detail
* Ability to present oneself professionally and thrive in a fast-paced environment
* Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, and common SaaS tools
* Strong familiarity with administrative functions and server management in Discord

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher
* US work authorization required
* Portfolio, write-up, or demo of a workflow or process you’ve automated or improved using AI

**Career Foundations & Growth Tracks**

While this is an entry-level role, we place a strong emphasis on internal promotion and long-term growth. The ideal career progression moves from this role into supervising future AI-First Admin Coordinators, with potential advancement toward school leadership and school board governance positions. Elite works with each employee to ensure personal development, diverse experiences, and notable growth in the following areas:

* AI Operations & Process Engineering
* Management – Hiring, Training, Team Development
* Local or Regional Marketing
* Business or Brand Development – New Campus Startup or Established Campus Development
* Seminars and Public Speaking
* Public or International School Relations
* International Project Coordination
* Technology – AI Implementation, EdTech Development, Google Services, Systems Integration

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Full-Time: $35,000 – $45,000 annually
* Monthly Salary with Structured Bonuses
* Health Care
* Career Building Foundation
* Best Company Culture and Teamwork

**More About Elite Open School**

We aim to prepare students for the 4th Industrial Revolution. The acceleration in AI, robotics, biotech, and automation demands that we equip students with creativity, advanced communication, critical thinking, and cognitive flexibility. Elite Open School is uniquely “Open” to creativity-based education through multilingual campuses, digital and adaptive curriculum, individualized pacing, and unlimited experiential learning opportunities.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Restaurant365 is transforming how restaurants run their businesses. Today, we help more than 50,000 restaurant locations manage their finances, operations, and people. As AI changes what's possible, we're reimagining how restaurant back offices operate—automating routine work, helping teams make better decisions, and giving restaurant leaders more time to focus on growing their businesses.

We're transforming how we work, too. AI is changing how we build products, solve problems, and deliver results for our customers. We're embracing new ways of working, moving faster, and creating opportunities for our people to make a greater impact.

At Restaurant365, our culture is built on ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We believe in challenging ourselves, learning every day, and working together to achieve great results. We're looking for people who are curious, take initiative, and want to grow while helping shape the future of an industry.

The Implementation Specialist is a key member of the Professional Services team, responsible for guiding customers through the onboarding process—from initial setup through successful adoption and go-live. This role focuses on delivering a smooth, timely, and high-quality implementation experience for small to mid-market customers, ensuring that each client is set up for long-term success with R365’s platform. The Specialist will partner closely with Project Managers, Solutions Architects, and Customer Success Managers to configure solutions, deliver training, and ensure customers understand how to use the system effectively in their day-to-day operations. While the primary focus will be on execution, this role will also contribute to process improvements and knowledge sharing within the team to help drive consistent delivery standards.

* Other duties as assigned.

* Utilization Rate

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to lead client-facing trainings and translate technical concepts into clear, actionable guidance for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Strong interpersonal and customer service orientation, with the confidence to lead customer conversations, build trust, and guide decision-making during critical phases of implementation.

* Familiarity with restaurant industry operations and workflows (e.g., accounting, POS, inventory) with the ability to contextualize SaaS solutions to meet operational needs.

* Highly analytical and solutions-oriented, able to assess requirements, troubleshoot issues, and make timely, data-informed decisions that support customer success.

* Self-starter with the ability to work independently, while also demonstrating strong collaboration skills when working cross-functionally with Project Managers, Engineers, Product, and Customer Success.

* Proven SaaS tool fluency, sound technical knowledge, and detail orientation.
* Curiosity and eagerness to use AI in your daily work, backed by hands-on experience, a good sense of what generative AI can and can't do, and the judgment to verify its outputs.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Experience with multi-unit restaurant groups.

* Exposure to ERP systems or launch-of-service delivery.

* Comfort adapting to evolving playbooks and tools.

This is a grant/categorically funded position. Continuation of this position is contingent upon available funding on a year to year basis.

1. Coordinate the daily services and activities of the CalWORKs program and activities related to foster youth and students who are homeless or at-risk of becoming homeless.  
  
2. Develop the CalWORKs program plan and budget; coordinate budget planning activities and monitor expenditures; prepare monthly budget reports and year-end accountability report; serve as a liaison for both internal and external departments and agencies.

jobs.description:
**Femmes Against Violence Program**  
**Program Coordinator**

***Full-time, Union Position***

Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco, Inc. (Horizons), established in 1965, is a community-based organization located in the Mission District and offers substance use prevention and early intervention, employment/workforce development, mental health and wellness, multimedia arts, and gender-affirming services, to Latine and all youth of color, up to age 24, and their families residing in the Mission District and throughout San Francisco.

Our programs help young people understand the systems that create inequality and how those systems affect their lives. We create safe spaces where they can make sense of their experiences, build healthy coping skills, and find their own power within these systems. Young people leave with the tools to take care of themselves and their communities and to create real change on their own terms.

**Program Description:** Femmes Against Violence (FAV) is an 18-week, cohort-based program that promotes healing, agency, leadership, and self-determination among youth ages 14–21, including femme-identified and gender-expansive youth of color. Offered twice annually, FAV engages youth three days per week through culturally affirming, gender-responsive, youth-centered programming.

The program integrates intersectional, liberatory frameworks grounded in Black feminist theory, Indigenous teachings, ancestral knowledge, collective care, and community accountability through interactive workshops, experiential activities, community outings, guest speakers, and youth-led action projects. Programming explores identity, culture, relationships, gender-based violence prevention, systems of power and oppression, and pathways toward personal and collective well-being. Youth develop critical consciousness, leadership, advocacy, communication, and self-determination skills while engaging in opportunities to apply their learning through creative and experiential activities.

FAV also provides a wraparound support model that connects youth to mental health and wellness, case management, educational, housing, and other community resources. FAV creates a supportive space where youth can build belonging, strengthen their voices and leadership capacity, develop healthy coping and relationship skills, and envision and pursue futures grounded in care, justice, and self-determination.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and oversee delivery of the FAV program in accordance with the approved work plan and scope of services, including outreach and recruitment, orientation and enrollment, life skills, peer education, leadership development, culturally and gender-affirming activities and events, youth-led projects, and related services.

* Facilitate culturally and gender-affirming trainings, workshops, group activities, presentations, and community outings for FAV participants.

* Work collaboratively with other Horizons programs to ensure a cohesive program model and coordinated services for participating youth.

* Network and participate in community committees, meetings, and collaborative efforts that promote FAV, strengthen partnerships, and expand resources and opportunities for participants.
* Coordinate with participants and staff to implement evaluation and feedback tools that measure program effectiveness, participant satisfaction, and progress toward program outcomes.

* Facilitate connections to wraparound and support services, including mental health and wellness, case management, educational, housing, and other community resources.

jobs.title: Community Manager (San Francisco)
jobs.description:
Hey! We’re team Granola We’re building the leading AI-powered notepad for people in back-to-back meetings, a product that’s spreading through teams and redefining how knowledge is captured and used. We help teams turn messy call notes into structured insight, so they can spend more time focusing on what’s important and less time on admin.

**Why we care about community**
-------------------------------

When people find Granola, they tend to really love it. Community is how we bring that feeling offline, into a room with other people who feel the same.

We’ve run 100+ events with more than 5,000 people, starting in London, and learnt a lot about what makes people come back.

In SF, we’ve opened an office and run a number of events, experimenting as we go: our GTM Series, a demo night with Linear, a GTM hackathon with Anthropic and more. Now we’re looking for someone to take it beyond the experimental phase and build a well-oiled machine, known as one of the best places in SF for tech community and events.

We don’t measure community in signups. It’s brand marketing, and it’s how we show people what Granola is like in person.

### **Our goal**

Make Granola one of the best AI-native, human brands for professionals.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

You’ll own generating event ideas and community initiatives and the execution those ideas:

* Come up with event and community ideas, and think hard about what makes an event special
* Curate the guest list so a great group of people show up
* Own all comms with speakers, partners and guests
* Run logistics like a station master, so everything leaves on time
* Own the marketing for every event, from the copy to the socials, so the room is full
* Work closely with our brand and events teams in London, who hold the bar on how Granola shows up
* Pitch in on big product launches when we need all hands
* Build relationships with the top accelerators and VCs in the Bay (e.g. YC, Neo, HF0, SPC). Be there when new cohorts land, so Granola is the first tool founders reach for on day one

**How you’ll know it’s working**
--------------------------------

* Within 6 months, people in SF say Granola puts on some of the best tech events in the city
* Before that:

  + Your events fill up are oversubscribed with the relevant folks for each event
  + Great event and community ideas keep coming
  + You own and run logistics like clockwork

**About you**
-------------

**Your background**

* 5+ years in community and events, venture, startup ecosystems or partnerships
* A track record of running great events for a tech audience consistently
* Comfortable talking to execs and founders

**Bonus points**

* A strong network in Bay Area tech, with relationships across founders, accelerators or VCs

**As a person, you**

* **Work autonomously.** You set direction together with Shre and the team, then run with it. Take feedback well - you get curious, adjust quickly, and show the change in your next piece of work
* **Sweat the details.** For every event, you think about the one thing that will make people remember it and feel special. You treat the attendee experience like a user flow: from the moment someone arrives outside our office, to checking in, to knowing where the bathroom is before they have to ask
* **Get startups and tech.** You’re always reading, listening and learning about the fastest-growing startups, founders and operators, and you know what founders care about
* **Have great judgment.** You come up with original ideas and have the instincts to know what’s right for Granola’s brand. Our bar is high, and you’re always open to learning how to meet it
* **Roll up your sleeves.** This is a founding community role. You’re as comfortable emailing a unicorn founder as you are Ubering to a restaurant yourself to pick up pizza boxes if DoorDash is horrendously late to make sure everyone’s fed. No task is beneath you
* **Love being around people.** You get energy from meeting people, can work a crowd, and can say no politely but firmly
* **Embody the core Granola traits:** hardworking, kind and incredibly ambitious

**Compensation**
----------------

Base salary: $150,000–$180,000, depending on experience, plus equity

We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart’s demo in 1968 and we want to assemble the best crew to build this future together.

Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity.

Lastly, we think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what is written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out.

Compensation Range: $150K - $180K

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

**RECRUITING COORDINATOR**

We're looking for individuals with a knack for attention to detail, organization, and coordination. Our Recruiting Coordinators handle everything from scheduling interviews to tracking candidate data and ensuring that candidates have a lasting positive experience throughout the interview process. The ideal candidate has interest and may have experience working in a fast-paced, startup-like environment while wearing multiple hats to ensure our candidates have a positive experience at every stage of the recruiting process. Availability, flexibility, and adaptability are the keys to success in this role.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Play a crucial role within a fast-paced environment while working to coordinate and manage onsite and virtual candidate interviews
* Schedule candidate interviews and handle any type of candidate logistics promptly and accurately
* Host candidates onsite and create a candidate experience that's warm, human, and memorable
* Represent and facilitate exceptional partnerships with all stakeholders, candidates, hiring managers, and interviewers to drive excellent customer service and consistent, high-quality work
* Drive and participate in process improvement initiatives and other special projects
* Ensure data integrity by updating candidate records in the applicant tracking system, Greenhouse
* Evaluate and recommend recruitment strategies and solutions to make our processes more efficient

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED SKILLS OR QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Excellent organizational, project management, and multitasking abilities
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Previous experience in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to manage multiple on-going projects, be flexible to change, and adapt to shifting priorities
* Team player with a high sense of urgency
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Prior experience in people operations or recruiting functions

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* This role is based at our Palo Alto office and is fully in-office, 5 days per week
* Available to occasionally work overtime, as schedules vary with operational needs; flexibility is key

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**

$80,000 - $100,000 USD

  

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Location**: Swayable is hybrid in-office 3x a week!

Swayable is a fast-growing AI and automated data science platform that measures public opinion, and the impact of messages and advertising content on it. We are a 50-person team backed by top technology and social impact investors, including Y Combinator. Founded in 2018 by physics PhDs, it is led by the former Executive Director for Digital Strategy at the New York Times. Clients include major consumer-facing brands (JP Morgan Chase, Airbnb, Paramount Pictures), technology companies (Anthropic, Meta, Amazon), academic researchers (MIT, Yale, Stanford) and mission-aligned civic advocacy campaigns (e.g. on climate, human rights and elections). Check our our values & culture deck to learn more: https://tinyurl.com/4zjchwzs

Joining Swayable means being on a team whose work changes the course of history. The technology we develop is at the leading edge of transforming some of the world's most important campaign organizations and enterprises: combatting disinformation, protecting democracy, and supporting the sustainable growth of consumer-facing brands.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a driven, resourceful Sales Development Representative to open doors at some of the world's most influential brands. Based in San Francisco and reporting directly to our Chief Revenue Officer, you'll identify prospective customers, earn their attention, and turn initial conversations into qualified sales opportunities.

This is an opportunity to build your sales career with direct access to an experienced revenue leader and meaningful ownership from day one. You'll learn how enterprise deals get built, sharpen your commercial instincts, and have a visible impact on Swayable's growth. You should be excited by the daily work it takes to get there: researching accounts, picking up the phone, testing messages, and following through when the first attempt doesn't land.

**What You'll Do**

* **Build pipeline:** Generate qualified sales opportunities through consistent, thoughtful outreach across phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels.
* **Find the right people:** Research target accounts and identify decision-makers across marketing, consumer insights, brand strategy, and creative teams.
* **Make outreach relevant:** Connect Swayable's capabilities to a prospect's business, priorities, and challenges, giving them a compelling reason to engage.
* **Qualify opportunities:** Lead initial conversations to understand prospective customers' needs and set the sales team up for productive next steps.
* **Improve the approach:** Work directly with the CRO to test messaging, refine targeting, and turn what you learn into a more effective prospecting process.
* **Own your execution:** Keep accurate CRM records, manage follow-ups, and take accountability for activity, qualified meetings, and pipeline goals.

**Who You Are**

* You have 1–2 years of professional experience, ideally in sales, business development, recruiting, or another role that requires proactive outreach and persistence.
* You're ambitious and self-motivated. You set a high bar for yourself and want your effort to translate into measurable results.
* You're willing to do the work. Cold calls, repeated follow-ups, and the consistency required to build pipeline are part of the challenge you're signing up for.
* You're a quick study who can understand a technical product, ask smart questions, and explain its value in clear, engaging language.
* You communicate confidently and concisely, whether you're writing an email or speaking with a senior marketing leader.
* You're resilient and resourceful. When an approach isn't working, you look for ways to improve and keep going.
* You actively seek feedback and put it into practice. You're excited to learn directly from the CRO and take increasing ownership as you develop.
* You're organized, dependable, and comfortable moving quickly in a startup environment.

**Benefits**:

* 100% Medical, Dental & Vision Plans - no employee contribution required
* Generous PTO
* Equity Options
* 401k plan, FSA
* Ongoing professional development investments
* Compensation: $65-75K base, $100-110K OTE

Swayable is an equal opportunity employer. We strive to promote an organizational environment that values diversity and fosters growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other basis prohibited by law. The team especially encourages applicants from underrepresented backgrounds.

Its technology helps finance teams streamline accounts receivable processes, reduce manual work, and improve collections efficiency.

We are seeking a motivated **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** with strong outbound prospecting skills to engage finance decision-makers, generate qualified sales opportunities, and help build a scalable sales development process.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prospect into mid-market and enterprise companies, targeting CFOs, Controllers, VPs of Finance, and Accounts Receivable leaders.
* Generate new pipeline through cold calling, personalized emails, LinkedIn outreach, and other outbound channels.
* Research target accounts and tailor messaging around accounts receivable challenges, slow collections, high days sales outstanding (DSO), and manual reconciliation.
* Qualify inbound leads based on business needs, timing, decision-making authority, and product fit.
* Schedule qualified discovery meetings and provide Account Executives with clear prospect notes and relevant business context.
* Meet or exceed monthly meeting, pipeline generation, and activity targets.
* Build, test, and improve outbound sequences, talk tracks, and prospecting strategies.
* Maintain accurate activity records, prospect information, and pipeline data in HubSpot.
* Share prospect feedback and market insights with sales, marketing, and product teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* 1–2 years of experience in a quota-carrying SDR or BDR role within B2B SaaS.
* Proven experience with cold calling and outbound prospecting, including generating pipeline through outbound channels.
* A track record of meeting or exceeding sales development targets.
* Strong written and verbal communication, organization, and time-management skills.
* Comfort using CRM systems and prospecting tools to manage outreach and sales activity.
* Curiosity, resilience, coachability, and a proactive approach to learning new products and markets.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in fintech, financial technology, ERP, or finance-related SaaS.
* Familiarity with accounts receivable, accounts payable, accounting, collections, or financial planning workflows.
* Experience with HubSpot, Apollo, Clay, or similar sales prospecting platforms.
* Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup.
* Familiarity with ERP platforms such as NetSuite or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Experience selling to finance and accounting decision-makers.

**Career Growth and Development**

Join an expanding sales team where you can contribute to outbound strategy, refine messaging, and work closely with founders and Account Executives. High-performing SDRs may have opportunities to progress into Account Executive roles through mentorship and internal career development.

**Compensation and Interview Process**

The compensation package includes a $75,000 annual base salary and approximately $30,000 in variable compensation at target performance. Additional incentives may be considered based on the employer's compensation plan.

jobs.description:
### **TRELLIS BUILDS AND DEPLOYS SELF-IMPROVING AGENTS TO GET PATIENTS ACCESS TO LIFE-SAVING MEDICINE.**

Our AI agents process billions of dollars worth of therapies annually with patients in all fifty states. We do this by automating document intake, prior authorizations, and appeals at scale to streamline operations and accelerate care. We classify medical referrals, understand chart notes, and automate contract and reimbursement search to provide patients with accurate coverage determinations and cost responsibility. Think of us as the infrastructure behind how patients get their medications.

Trellis is a spinout from Stanford AI Lab and is backed by leading investors including YC, General Catalyst, Telesoft Partners, and executives at Google and Salesforce.

### **THE ROLE**

We're hiring two Sales Development Representatives to help build our growth team. You'll be the first conversation many healthcare leaders have with Trellis. Your job is to find the right people, start great conversations, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives. You'll work closely with our GTM Engineer and AEs, and report to Mike Barbour (VP of Sales).

This role is built for early-career people with a steep learning curve. You'll learn how specialty pharmacies, infusion centers, provider groups, and health systems get patients on therapy, and you'll have a clear path to grow into a closing role.

Compensation: The pay range listed is on-target earnings (OTE), including base salary and commission.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**Job Description**

In order to be considered for this position candidate must be serving permanently in the title, or reachable on the civil service list.
  
  
The Transportation Planning and Management Division (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility and markings, and ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  
  
Research, Implementation, and Safety unit (RIS) is a multi-disciplinary team dedicated to making the streets of New York City safer for all users as part of Vision Zero, a citywide policy striving to eliminate serious injuries and fatalities from traffic crashes. School Safety, a unit within RIS, is responsible for improving safety near K-12 schools throughout New York City. The group redesigns streets next to schools with a goal of reducing child injuries, improving safety and accessibility, and encouraging non-motorized transportation in all five boroughs. jobs.description:
The Workplace Experience Program Specialist owns employee events, programs, and experience initiatives end-to-end, from initial brief and stakeholder alignment through planning, production, and post-initiative review, and serves as the primary workplace experience partner to our senior leaders. This role is New York, USA-based.

The Specialist operates independently across a varied portfolio of concurrent work, managing vendors, cross-functional partners, and budgets. Success requires the ability to move fluidly between strategic advisory and hands-on delivery shaping the brief with a department head one day, managing a venue walkthrough the next.

**Key Responsibilities**

Event Planning & Delivery

Own assigned events from end-to-end, from brief through delivery and post-event wrap. The scope, scale, and complexity of what is owned increases with seniority, as does the degree of independent judgement expected at each stage.

* Own end-to-end delivery of employee events, programs, and experience initiatives across the US
* Build project plans, run-of-show documents, and risk plans for complex or large-scale events
* Manage vendor sourcing, negotiations, contracts, and on-site relationships
* Oversee full budget management: forecasting, reconciliation, and reporting
* Coordinate cross-functional support (facilities, IT, People team, etc.) to ensure seamless execution
* Ensure legal and compliance requirements are met across all event-related procurement

Stakeholder Partnership

* Serve as the primary workplace experience partner to department heads and People leadership in the US
* Lead stakeholder briefings and alignment sessions; translate business intent into experience design
* Advise on event strategy: help leadership determine the right format, investment level, and experience goals
* Manage expectations proactively; navigate competing priorities and tight timelines with clarity

Standards & Process

* Apply and uphold our event and experience execution standards; adapt frameworks for the US market context
* Contribute to the development and refinement of global event standards, playbooks, and the service catalog
* Introduce new event formats and experience approaches that raise the bar for employee programming
* Maintain accurate records: post-event documentation, budget actuals, attendance data, and learnings

Data & Continuous Improvement

* Own the US events measurement approach: collect, analyze, and report on experience quality and employee sentiment
* Produce post-event reports and strategic write-ups; link outcomes to broader employee experience goals
* Analyze trends across the US event portfolio to inform future program investment and priorities

Collaboration & Teamwork

* Work closely with the global Workplace Experience team to align the US event portfolio with broader workplace experience strategy
* Partner with the Experience Design team on integrated experiences where events connect to broader business outcomes
* Represent the Workplace Experience function in US-based cross-functional planning forums

**What We're Looking For**

Genuine passion for employee experience, the ability to operate independently across a varied and concurrent portfolio, and the credibility to partner with senior leaders on experience strategy.

* At least 4-6 years of experience, including ownership of large-scale events or employee experience programs
* Proven track record delivering events and programs from concept through completion- on time, on brand, and on budget
* Strategic thinker who can move between vision and execution without losing either
* Strong stakeholder manager: shapes briefs, manages expectations at leadership level, and advocates for the employee experience
* Comfortable developing playbooks, processes, and standards- both for their own work and as contributions to the broader global team
* Deep knowledge of event production: vendor markets, technical production, and logistics
* Self-directed and adaptable; comfortable owning the full delivery chain independently

*There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, roles are eligible to be considered for an annual bonus and equity grant.*

*The range for the NYC-metro area is: $110,291 - $122,545*

**E-Verify Program Participant**

We are an E-Verify employer – meaning that your Form I-9 information will be provided to the federal government to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

For more information, please view: E-Verify Participation Poster (English/Spanish) and IER Right to Work Poster (English/Spanish)

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

The Belfer Center for Innovation & Social Impact is seeking a highly organized and collaborative Program Coordinator to support the Center’s operations and growing portfolio of programs.

Reporting to the Senior Director and working closely with the Belfer Center team, the Program Coordinator will maintain the systems, logistics, communications, and administrative processes that keep the Center’s work moving forward. The role will also provide programmatic support across initiatives focused on leadership development, community building, civic engagement, and social innovation.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys creating structure, coordinating across teams, and contributing to meaningful programs in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment. The ideal candidate is thoughtful, detail-oriented, and comfortable balancing a range of responsibilities.

We welcome candidates from a variety of professional backgrounds. Previous experience in the nonprofit, arts and culture, or social impact sectors is helpful but not required.

Job Responsibilities Include:

* Support the day-to-day operations of the Belfer Center, including designated email accounts, calendars, files, contact lists, and shared team resources.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings, including scheduling, preparation of materials, agendas, notes, action items, and follow-up.
* Provide administrative and coordination support across the Belfer Center’s programs and initiatives, including research, written materials, presentations, and participant communications.
* Coordinate logistics for meetings, workshops, public programs, cohort gatherings, receptions, and other events, including room reservations, food and beverage, invitations, RSVPs, registration, materials, and on-site needs.
* Work with 92NY departments and external partners to support program and event planning and execution.
* Support communications and relationships with program participants, alumni, partners, speakers, and other members of the Belfer Center community.
* Attend selected programs and events, including occasional evening and weekend events, to provide on-site support.
* Work with the Belfer Center team and 92NY’s Finance Department to process invoices, payments, reimbursements, contracts, and related documentation, and assist with budget tracking and expense reconciliation.
* Maintain and improve internal systems, project-management tools, databases, workflows, templates, and recurring procedures.
* May be assigned other tasks and duties reasonably related to the role.

Experience, Education, & Skills Desired:

* Bachelor’s degree.
* 2-3 years of relevant work experience.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and details simultaneously.
* Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, polished work.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues and partners.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic environment where priorities may evolve.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace, and using project-management, database, email marketing, survey, registration, and customer relationship management platforms. Experience with tools such as Monday.com, HubSpot, Salesforce, Typeform, Mailchimp, or similar platforms is helpful.
* Previous experience supporting nonprofit programs, events, fundraising, operations, or administrative systems is helpful but not required.
* Interest in social impact, innovation, community building, and the mission and values of 92NY.

Work Environment & Requirements:

40 hours/week onsite at 92NY. Monday through Friday, 9am to 6pm, with a one-hour unpaid meal break.

Occasional evening or weekend availability may be required to support programs and events.

Application Instructions

Interested applicants should forward a resume and a cover letter with salary requirements.

Due to a high volume of applications that we receive, we are only able to contact those applicants whose experience most aligns with the position profile.

Compensation Range

$50,000 - $55,000

*The actual compensation offered will be based on a number of factors including, but not limited to the qualifications of the applicant, years of relevant experience, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and if applicable, the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.*

**About The Belfer Center**

The Belfer Center for Innovation & Social Impact is 92NY’s social impact laboratory, incubating and scaling initiatives that strengthen community, expand opportunity, and drive civic participation.

Since 2013, the Center has launched more than 20 initiatives that have collectively activated over 100 million people. Its largest initiative, Giving Tuesday, has grown into a global movement generating billions each year for organizations worldwide.

The Center operates with a start-up mindset within one of New York City’s most established institutions, combining innovation, community, and large-scale impact.
