jobs.description:
ASAP Academic Program Specialist (Academic ASAP Student Advisor)

**POSITION DETAILS**

Founded in 1971 in Long Island City, Queens **,** LaGuardia Community College is one of seven community colleges of the City University of New York (CUNY). LaGuardia offers more than sixty associate degree programs and more than fifty workforce training, ESOL, GED, and pre-college programs. In 2023, LaGuardia served approximately 24,000 students. More than one-third of LaGuardia’s degree-seeking students are born outside the United States; they come from 136 countries and speak 43 heritage languages. Sixty percent are first-generation college students.

Virtually all LaGuardia students are ethnic minorities (89 percent), 58 percent are women, 27 percent are over the age of 25. Forty-six percent of associate degree students are Hispanic. Upon graduation most students transfer to four-year colleges, typically in CUNY, to complete their baccalaureate degrees. Graduates of career programs such as Nursing, Computer Technology, and Veterinary Technology enter the workforce. LaGuardia ranked fifth among U.S. community colleges in economic mobility – moving low-income students into the middle class and beyond – in studies by Stanford University (2017) and the Brookings Institution (2020). Please visit www.laguardia.edu to learn more.

Accelerated Study in Associate Programs (ASAP) helps motivated community college students earn degrees as quickly as possible, with a goal of graduating at least 50% of students within three years. Key ASAP program features include a consolidated block schedule, cohorts by major, required full-time study, mandatory tutoring, and comprehensive advisement and career development services. Financial incentives include tuition waivers for financial aid-eligible students and free use of textbooks and monthly Transportation support for all students. Further information is available at www.cuny.edu/ASAP About ASAP Labor & Employment Law

Reporting to the Associate Director for Collaborative Strategy (or designee), the ASAP Academic Support Specialist is responsible for coordinating and strengthening academic support initiatives that promote student persistence, engagement, and degree completion. The Specialist collaborates across the ASAP team, faculty, and campus partners to expand tutoring, supplemental instruction, academic workshops, STEM initiatives, and other learning support strategies while monitoring participation, evaluating effectiveness, and utilizing data to improve student outcomes. The Program Specialist will perform duties including but not limited to the following:

* Coordinate academic support programming and supports implementation of STEM initiatives.
* Oversee ASAP Resource Center and services and manage ASAP Resource Center Tutors
* Promote tutoring, SI, workshops, and learning opportunities
* Coordinate tutor recruitment, scheduling, and training.
* Student Success & Intervention; collaborate with advisors on academic interventions
* Connect students with appropriate campus resources and develop academic support materials.
* Data Management & Assessments; monitors participation and attendance, tracks student engagement, and analyzes outcomes
* Prepare required Central Office reports.
* Partner with faculty and campus departments, supports innovative academic support initiatives, and participates in Central Office workgroups.
* Perform other related duties as assigned and has flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred) in an appropriate discipline and four years related experience.

PREFERRED QUALIDICATIONS

* Experience supporting community college students.
* Experience coordinating tutoring or academic support programs.
* Understanding of barriers facing urban community college students.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience working with student information systems and data.
* Microsoft Office proficiency (Excel, Access, Word).
* Ability to analyze data and prepare reports.
* Ability to work collaboratively across departments.
* Ability to facilitate workshops or trainings.

Accelerated Study in Associate Programs (ASAP) helps students earn their college degree as quickly as possible, by removing the financial, academic, and personal obstacles that many students confront. Key ASAP program features include a consolidated block schedule, cohorts by major, required full-time study and comprehensive advisement and career development services. Financial incentives include tuition waivers for financial aid eligible students, yearly textbook vouchers, and MetroCards for all students. Further information is available at www.cuny.edu/ASAP.

The ASAP Advisor is a member of an integrated College team providing individual academic, career and related support to an assigned group of college students as they progress through the program.

* Delivers comprehensive advisement support services to an assigned group of students through degree completion
* Conducts workshops and group advisement on topics of relevance and interest
* Reviews student progress and tracks student use of academic support services
* Conducts regular outreach to faculty and other college staff as needed to support student success
* Maintains accurate tracking data and notes for each assigned student, recommending appropriate referrals and opportunity programs

**Overview**

What began in 2017 as an idea on the back of a napkin has quickly become an award-winning, fastest-growing communications firm working with some big-name consumer and B2B technology brands. At SourceCode, we’re focused on bringing brains and hustle, humanity and technology, creativity and business intelligence back to public relations.

SourceCode’s Account Coordinators are not expected to remain on the sidelines of an account and are encouraged to be active, curious, and collaborative members of the team. We’re looking for a motivated professional with 0–1 years of PR experience (or strong internship background) to become a valued teammate and foundational support for our clients. We want our Account Coordinators to take on real responsibilities and embrace opportunities that help them grow rapidly as professionals. Opportunity here is earned, initiative is rewarded, and success is celebrated across the wider team.

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Draft Client Materials:** Write press releases, media pitches, and client reports, collaborating with senior team members to refine and polish content.
* **Build Media Networks**: Conduct research to build targeted media lists using tools like Muck Rack, support daily outreach, and pitch stories with a goal of converting opportunities 60%–70% of the time.
* **Monitor Coverage & Trends**: Track media coverage and analyze Muck Rack data to identify industry themes and trends for regular client reports.
* **Client Communication**: Liaise with client contacts over Slack, email, and status calls to deliver updates and draft client messages with minimal edits.
* **News Monitoring**: Read and share relevant daily news that connects to client priorities, helping to identify and lead rapid-response media opportunities.
* **Campaign Tracking**: Monitor speaker opportunities, awards, event calendars, and seasonal editorial calendars to maximize client success.
* **Influencer & Social Support**: Research and identify targeted influencers and assist with social calendar management and content creation.
* **Account Logistics**: Deliver accurate meeting agendas, action items, call reports, and recap emails to team leads for review.
* **Project Management**: Coordinate and track account workflows across teams to ensure timely delivery of services.

* **Goal Alignment**: Maintain awareness of client goals and KPIs, proactively alerting team members with recommendations if tasks fall behind schedule.

* **Business Development**: Support agency growth by participating and taking an active role in business development.

Designed to balance focused remote work with the collaborative energy of our headquarters located conveniently near Penn Station.

 **Requirements**

* **Strong Writing & Research Skills**: Ability to research a business or industry and compose a thoughtful, well-crafted position on a relevant topic.
* **Fast-Paced Project Management**: Exceptional organizational and time-management skills, with a meticulous attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple priorities without sacrificing quality.
* **Workload & Boundary Management**: The confidence to clearly communicate your workload to team members, proactively managing and resetting expectations across multiple deadlines when necessary.
* **Creative Problem-Solving**: Curiosity to ask the right questions, a willingness to figure things out, and a passion for pushing beyond "one-size-fits-all" strategies to try new things.
* **Start-Up Mindset:** An ambitious, adaptable, and hard-working attitude with the ability to think on your feet, meet strict deadlines, and actively contribute to a growing team's success.

The Division of Youth and Family Justice (DYFJ) provides a wide range of services and programs for youth at every stage of the juvenile justice process. Our goals are to (a) build stronger and safer communities and advance public safety by preventing juveniles from entering the New York City's juvenile justice system, (b) provide therapeutic treatment and services to youth in our custodial care, and (c) help juveniles access the tools they need to leave the justice system for good. jobs.title: Programmatic Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Wunderkind:**

Wunderkind ads are 'behaviorally triggered', meaning that ads are served on a premium list of publishers only when a user is done consuming content. Our proprietary tag is integrated directly on the publisher page to track on-site user behavior - making '**net new'** ad placements. *How* we serve the ad is why we are different from our competitors in-market.

Rather than placing an ad in front of someone while they're actively trying to read content, our technology patiently waits until a visitor has stopped reading before rendering our ad on the page. And that patience pays off - it turns out that when an ad experience respects the user's reason for visiting a page, the user respects the ad experience in return. This unique, brand safe approach to ad experience gives an advertiser's message more attention and greater engagement.

**About the Role:**

Here at Wunderkind, we have an innovative and truly differentiated enterprise product that fundamentally changes how publishers monetize their websites and you can play a key part in leading that shift.

Wunderkind Ads is looking for a top-performing Account Manager to work with our existing business team to retain and expand agency, trading desk, brand and DSP accounts across the midwest region. We are looking for someone with a proven track record of driving retention and building healthy client relationships. You will be given tremendous responsibility early on, immediately start to build a network of relationships from leading agencies, and have the chance to directly contribute to the explosive growth of Wunderkind as a key player in the market.

This role is **Hybrid** (3 days in-office) from our **NYC Office,** One World Trade Center

**Responsibilities:**

* Manage and grow a roster of key agency relationships
* Work closely with Sales to expand revenue streams for existing accounts
* Become an expert on the use and best practices of Wunderkind
* Offer clients insight on how to launch and improve campaigns across Wunderkind inventory
* Provide ongoing management to clients as new features and inventory are added to our repertoire
* Work with Product Management to help define and innovate features of the platform
* Help develop operationalize best practices by creating training materials, sales materials and customer facing guides

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of online advertising experience required; 1+ years of client-facing experience
* Expertise in working with programmatic ad inventory, DSPs, ad exchanges, ad servers, and other optimization platforms is a plus
* Experience managing CPA, CPC, and CPM marketing campaigns

**Additional Qualifications:**

* Outstanding troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities coupled with superb communication skills to relay your solutions
* Detail-oriented with the ability to project manage, set priorities and meet deadlines when managing multiple client relationships
* Motivated, tenacious, and resourceful
* Persuasive and compelling - able to communicate on behalf of Wunderkind in formal and informal settings
* Comfortable in a high-growth environment where roles and responsibilities may shift
* Entrepreneurial spirit with a passion for the marketing technology space and a healthy dose of humility

*On the fence? Apply anyway! We know that imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting incredible candidates, and don't want it to get in the way of meeting you!*

*The base salary range for this role is $80,000-87,500. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each specific candidate; including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, applicable certifications, and geographic work location. This may vary depending on living location and market rate.*

jobs.title: Digital Marketing & Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
Our growing law firm is seeking a creative, motivated, and results-driven **Digital Marketing & Social Media Manager** to oversee our digital marketing, social media presence, paid advertising, content creation, and community outreach initiatives.

We are looking for someone who can develop and implement marketing strategies to increase our firm's visibility, strengthen our brand, engage with potential clients, and help expand our presence in the communities we serve.

The ideal candidate will be creative, organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple marketing projects independently.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Social Media Management**

* Manage the firm's social media accounts, including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube.
* Create and maintain a consistent social media posting schedule.
* Develop engaging posts, stories, reels, and short-form videos.
* Monitor social media engagement, comments, and messages.

**2. Content Creation & Video Production**

* Create professional and engaging content highlighting our legal services, attorneys, firm activities, and community involvement.
* Film, edit, and produce short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts.
* Design marketing graphics, flyers, advertisements, and promotional materials.
* Develop educational legal content in collaboration with our attorneys.

**3. Paid Digital Advertising**

* Create, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Google.
* Identify target audiences and develop advertising strategies to reach potential clients.
* Monitor advertising budgets and campaign performance.
* Track leads, engagement, and advertising results.
* Recommend improvements to maximize marketing effectiveness and return on investment.

**4. Community Outreach & Business Development**

* Identify community organizations, businesses, cultural associations, and local groups for potential partnerships.

* Reach out to organizations to arrange speaking engagements and presentations about our firm's legal services.
* Assist in planning community outreach events, educational programs, and promotional activities.
* Build and maintain relationships with community leaders and organizations.
* Identify new opportunities to increase the firm's visibility and attract prospective clients.

**5. General Marketing & Brand Management**

* Develop and execute marketing campaigns to promote the law firm's services.
* Maintain consistent branding across social media, advertisements, websites, and printed marketing materials.
* Assist with website content updates and search engine optimization (SEO).
* Help manage the firm's Google Business Profile and online reputation.
* Develop creative strategies to promote the firm and strengthen its presence in the legal market.

* Provide monthly marketing reports and recommendations.
* Develop strategies to improve lead generation and brand awareness.

Qualifications

Interested candidates should submit:

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Strategist
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Fabuwood is seeking a results-driven Digital Marketing Specialist to own and execute the company's digital marketing programs across CRM and email, paid media and other digital channels.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move comfortably between strategy, execution, coordination, and analysis. The Digital Marketing Specialist will manage day-to-day CRM and email activity, oversee paid advertising, coordinate with internal teams and external partners, and continuously improve performance across the digital customer journey.

The role reports to the Digital Marketing Manager and owns the respective digital marketing metrics on Fabuwood's scorecard. Success requires strong follow-through, reliable reporting, and the ability to turn performance data into clear recommendations and next steps.

***Schedule: M-Th 8:00AM-5:00PM. F 8:00AM-12:00PM***

**Key Responsibilities**

CRM & Email Marketing

* Own the day-to-day management and execution of Fabuwood's CRM and email marketing program in HubSpot.
* Plan, build, test, schedule, and deploy email campaigns, including newsletters, product communications, promotions, event follow-up, onboarding, nurture, and re-engagement programs.
* Manage audience segmentation, lists, workflows, automation, personalization, lead routing, and lifecycle stages to ensure communications are relevant and timely.
* Monitor deliverability, engagement, conversions, list health, and campaign performance; use testing and analysis to continuously improve results.

Paid Media

* Lead the day-to-day management and oversight of paid digital media, whether executed internally or through agency and vendor partners.
* Support campaign strategy, audience targeting, budgets, creative requirements, landing pages, tracking, optimization, and reporting across channels such as Google, Meta, YouTube, display, and other relevant platforms.
* Review performance regularly and make recommendations to improve efficiency, lead quality, conversion, and return on marketing investment.

Metrics, Scorecard & Optimization

* Own the digital marketing metrics on Fabuwood's scorecard, including the accuracy, timeliness, definitions, targets, and reporting cadence for each assigned metric.
* Maintain dashboards and recurring reports covering accountable activity.
* Analyze performance by audience, campaign, channel, and funnel stage to identify trends, risks, gaps, and opportunities.
* Translate data into clear insights, recommendations, and action plans for the Digital Marketing Manager and broader marketing team.
* Work with internal stakeholders and partners to improve tracking, attribution, data quality, and reporting consistency.

Planning & Cross-Functional Execution

* Develop digital channel plans that support product launches, dealer initiatives, A+D programs, events, brand campaigns, and lead-generation goals.
* Manage digital marketing timelines, priorities, budgets, vendors, and deliverables, escalating risks or performance concerns when needed.
* Collaborate closely with creative, content, project management, sales, IT, and other teams to keep campaigns aligned and moving forward.
* Stay current on platform changes, digital best practices, privacy requirements, and emerging opportunities relevant to Fabuwood's audiences.

**Qualifications**

* 3-5 years of hands-on digital marketing experience across CRM/email, paid media, analytics, or related channels.
* Strong working knowledge of HubSpot or a comparable CRM and marketing automation platform, including email creation, segmentation, workflows, reporting, and database management.
* Experience managing or overseeing paid media campaigns and interpreting performance across major advertising platforms.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to maintain scorecard metrics, build clear reports, identify meaningful insights, and recommend next steps.
* Understanding of campaign tracking, conversion measurement, attribution, audience segmentation, and funnel performance.
* Excellent project-management, organizational, and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain performance clearly to both marketing and non-marketing stakeholders.
* A proactive, accountable mindset with strong attention to detail and a commitment to continuous improvement.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Looker Studio, and social media management or reporting tools.
* Familiarity with lead nurturing, A/B testing, and marketing attribution.
* Experience working with agencies, media partners, freelancers, or other outside vendors.
* Experience in cabinetry, building products, home improvement, manufacturing, or a dealer-based business model is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means Fabuwood's digital marketing programs are well planned, consistently executed, and clearly measured. CRM and email campaigns are timely and targeted, paid media are actively managed, digital projects move forward, and performance data is accurate and easy to understand.

The Digital Marketing Manager and broader team can rely on the Digital Marketing Specialist to own the details, surface meaningful insights, recommend improvements, and follow through on the actions needed to strengthen digital performance.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Development Representative (2)
jobs.description:
*Hey there, it’s Bram, the Director of Sales Development at Carv. I know the application process can often feel impersonal, so I wanted to leave a quick note on why you should consider joining Carv. Besides the fact that we’re an AI company offering a strong SDR salary and great benefits, we’re also an early-stage business.*  
  
*That means things move fast: direction changes constantly, and what you sold today might be obsolete tomorrow. In my eyes, that’s the best environment to truly learn* sales.  
  
At *Carv, SDRs have regular conversations with founders, but also a team and leader (me) dedicated to their success.*

#### **Major Benefits**

* Base Salary is between $65,000 - $75,000 with OTE up to $105,000+
* 100% Medical Coverage
Company trip to Amsterdam coming in December

#### **Carv’s Mission**

Simply to make human recruiting again. AI is a major buzzword, we understand that and while its a very competitive market we think by augmenting recruiters to do more candidate focused work we can fundamentally change the way Recruiting is done by Enterprise level companies.

#### **Day to Day**

For the most part, SDR’s remain the same, Cold Calling, Emailing, Prospecting, LinkedIn - We believe the difference is in the margins, while being consistent and organized are major pluses creativity is essential for an early stage company. Some of our recent initiatives include delivering bagels to local prospects in person, going to trade shows and conferences, sending champagne to new job starters, and soon we will be sending cameo’s to prospects — All of these were SDR driven and you have the same chance to make an impact in this way.

#### **Challenges**

It’s not all roses though, we understand that. We are in a challenging environment, one where AI is EVERYWHERE and we are trying to do one of the toughest things you can do in sales - break into the US market. This job isn’t for the faint of heart but if you can be successful in a bootstrapped startup your value increases dramatically for the future.

#### **Who you are**

Someone with strong business acumen that is quickly able to understand our prospects and the value proposition of Carv. The people who thrive in this role know how to balance their time between structured repetitive tasks and creative initiatives that move the needle with high level enterprise accounts

#### **Additional Benefits**

jobs.title: Retail Inventory & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Wolford**

Wolford represents the epitome of luxury and innovation in legwear and bodywear. With a rich heritage of knitting expertise and a global presence, we are committed to delivering exceptional quality, unmatched comfort, and a tailored customer experience. We empower our teams to exceed expectations, foster innovation, and contribute to the growth of a timeless, desirable brand.

**Join the World of Wolford — and help shape our future.**

**Position Overview**
=====================

The Retail Operations Coordinator is based at 609 Madison Avenue and is primarily responsible for the accurate and timely processing of shipments and merchandise movements across Wolford’s New York City boutiques. This hands-on role keeps merchandise organized, accurately recorded, and ready for the sales floor, allowing store leaders and brand ambassadors to focus on clients and selling.

Alongside NYC shipment responsibilities, the coordinator supports inventory accuracy, store standards, and operational processes across all Wolford boutiques in the US through inventory monitoring, process follow-up, and training support. The role partners closely with the Director of Retail, field leaders, and store leaders to identify issues, coordinate corrective actions, and maintain consistent operational standards.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**NYC Shipments and Merchandise Processing**
--------------------------------------------

* Own daily shipment receiving and processing for NYC boutiques, coordinating priorities and time across locations based on delivery volume and business needs.
* Unpack, count, inspect, and verify incoming merchandise against shipment documentation and advance shipping notices (ASNs); complete accurate receiving in NewStore.
* Identify shortages, overages, damages, and other delivery discrepancies; document issues and follow up with the appropriate teams through resolution.
* Prepare merchandise for the sales floor, including required labeling, security tagging, and replenishment, in partnership with store teams.
* Prepare and process outbound shipments, interstore transfers, and other approved merchandise movements, ensuring accurate documentation, system transactions, and shipment tracking.
* Maintain organized, safe receiving and stockroom areas, keeping product accessible and shipment materials cleared promptly.

**Inventory Accuracy and Control Across All US Boutiques**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Monitor open ASNs, negative on-hand balances, and open or aging transfers; follow up with stores to research discrepancies and complete required actions.
* Coordinate and track weekly cycle counts, required recounts, and inventory corrections; support stocktakes and discrepancy research.
* Monitor damage processing and ensure merchandise is documented, handled, and removed from sellable inventory according to company procedures.
* Identify recurring NewStore inventory issues and escalate unresolved discrepancies with clear supporting information.

**Additional Operational Responsibilities**
===========================================

**Store Standards and Operational Support Across All US Boutiques**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

* Support consistent execution of the Operations Manual and maintain best practices for stockroom organization, merchandise care, and inventory handling.
* Review stockroom standards during store visits and partner with store leaders to improve organization and workflow.
* Provide hands-on guidance and operational retraining on receiving, transfers, cycle counts, and related NewStore processes.
* Ensure store teams check returned or handled merchandise before restoring it to sellable stock, following company procedures.

**PR and Special Merchandise Movements**
----------------------------------------

* Coordinate store pulls for PR requests, communicating requirements and tracking product pulls, transfers, shipping, and returns as applicable.
* Support end-of-season transfers to Outlet or E-commerce and other approved special product movements.
* Provide operational assistance to headquarters for PR, damages, or other product handling needs as assigned.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Experience in retail stock, inventory, logistics, or store operations; luxury or specialty retail experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of receiving, transfers, cycle counts, and stockroom organization; NewStore experience preferred.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through, with the ability to balance shipment deadlines and administrative responsibilities.
* Clear communication skills and confidence supporting and training store teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and inventory or point-of-sale systems.
* Ability to perform the essential physical duties of receiving and moving merchandise, with reasonable accommodation as applicable, and to travel between NYC boutiques; occasional store visits as needed.

*Wolford is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

Northwest is seeking a creative, highly organized Brand Coordinator to create impact across our Family of Brands and support efforts that drive revenue, growth, and overall brand awareness. You may have been considered a jack of all trades before, which drove your big ideas, initiative, and desire to make a difference on the projects you supported. In this role, your versatility will enhance multiple marketing communications initiatives. You will support our Family of Brands through content creation, campaign execution, project management, social media, events, communications, and brand initiatives. Success in this role requires creativity, initiative, strong time management skills, and a passion for seeing a project or idea come to life.

You look for innovative, creative ways to grow brand recognition and awareness, create internal and external “Customers for Life”, and develop messages that keep people and the ‘why’ first. You enjoy working across departments to proactively make each project you lead and assist a success, helping to develop the message and materials that create impact. Developing brand materials and content and being able to seamlessly manage projects to completion will be a large focus for the Brand Coordinator position.

* Maintain brand voice and messaging consistency across communications
* Develop and maintain internal content calendar
* Partner with designers, agencies, and other creative resources to bring concepts and campaigns to life
* Review creative and content with a strong eye for brand consistency, messaging, accuracy, and overall quality

**Brand & Project Management**

* Coordinate multiple marketing projects simultaneously across the Family of Brands
* Work cross-functionally with internal teams and external agency partners to execute marketing initiatives
* Manage timelines, deliverables, approvals, and project rollouts
* Maintain campaign / content calendars
* Ensure projects continue to move forward from concept through completion

* Assist with day-to-day marketing administrative tasks, not limited to reporting, inventory management, and invoicing
* Must be able to lift 25 pounds

**Additional**

* Support all efforts to drive brand awareness, lead generation, and marketing projects of Northwest and all subsidiaries
* Assist with Communications and Public Relations needs, including press releases, articles, website updates, and internal and external announcements

* Must embody the Northwest Way, Service Standards, and Culture

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to think strategically and understand the bigger picture
* Self-motivated and comfortable working both collaboratively and independently

* Demonstrates strong judgment and understands what they can manage independently, when additional input is needed, and when something should be escalated

jobs.description:
Job ID: 530212

CRH's Americas Materials business is the leading provider of building materials in North America. The aggregates, asphalt, ready mixed concrete, paving and construction services we deliver are critical to building our world. Our operations span 45 U.S. states and two Canadian provinces with over 30,000 employees across 1,700 operating locations.

  

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a Project Operations Coordinator to serve as the on-site operations and administrative lead for our multi-year ERP implementation. Supporting a large project team , you will make sure everyone has what they need to do their best work, from access cards and supplies to meeting logistics. You will be the go-to person for the project team’s day-to-day needs, working closely with IT, Facilities, and project leadership to keep the project space running smoothly. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and service-minded, and thrives in a fast-paced environment with many moving parts.

**Location**

  

* 100% On-site

**What Shared Services Does**

A Shared Services Center (SSC) centralizes critical business processes, streamlining operations, reducing costs, and delivering consistent quality. By consolidating areas such as finance, procurement, payroll, and reporting, SSC eliminates duplication, frees time for strategic priorities, and fosters efficiency. SSC's primary functions include:

* **O2C (Order-to-Cash)**: Manages the customer journey from order to payment, driving smoother revenue processes.
* **R2R (Record-to-Report):** Enables robust financial reporting and accounting.
* **P2P (Procure-to-Pay):** Ensures timely vendor payments and strong supplier relationships. Manages the Travel and Expense program.
* **Center of Excellence:** Drives innovation and continuous improvement.
* **Payroll (Hire-to-Retire):** Ensures accurate, compliant employee payments.

Shared Services enables companies to focus on growth and strategic goals while maintaining operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for the ERP implementation project team’s day-to-day office and logistical needs.
* Coordinate onboarding and offboarding logistics for project team members, including access cards, seat assignments, equipment requests with IT, and welcome information.
* Maintain accurate project team rosters, seating charts, and access lists, and audit them regularly.
* Assist with coordinating office catering and food service arrangements for meetings, training sessions, and employee events.
* Act as a backup resource for ordering, stocking, and maintaining office and breakroom supplies.
* Manage conference room reservations and resolve scheduling conflicts.
* Support the operation and maintenance of office systems, including:
  + Verkada Security System
  + Yodeck Content Management System
  + Facilities Expense Tracking and reporting tools
* Support the project leadership team with meeting preparation, calendars, action-item tracking, and logistics for workshops, trainings, and go-live activities.
* Coordinate on-site visitors, consultants, and vendors.
* Track project-related administrative expenses and invoices, and prepare regular reports.
* Respond to project team requests and escalate issues to the right internal stakeholders (IT, Facilities, HR, Management).
* Proactively identify and implement improvements to keep the project space efficient and organized.
* Provide additional support during critical project milestones, including go-live, which may require extended hours.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Education & Qualifications**

  

* High School diploma required.
* 3+ years of administrative, office management, or project coordination experience
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Teams, Excel, Outlook) and comfort learning new systems required
* Experience coordinating meetings and event logistics preferred.
* Exceptional organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer service orientation with the ability to build positive working relationships across all levels of the organization.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information
* Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities
* Ability to work 8:00AM – 5:00PM EST with some flexibility around meetings. The position may require occasionally working outside of normal business hours.

**Work Environment**

  

* Ability to move throughout the office to support meetings, events, and facilities-related activities.
* Ability to occasionally lift and move office supplies and materials up to 30 pounds.
* Ability to sit, stand, and work at a computer for extended periods of time.

**What CRH Offers You**

  

* Highly competitive base pay
* Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs
* Group retirement savings program
* Health and wellness programs
* An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion

**About CRH**

CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. CRH operates in a decentralized, diversified structure that allows you to work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large international organization.

Welcome to Manhattan. Every day, our supply chain commerce technology connects two billion people to 20 billion consumer choices. In the warehouse, on the road and in the store, we make what was once impossible, possible. If you want to tackle complex problems and redefine markets, you’ve come to the right place.

The Partner Operations Program Coordinator will help the Global Partner Operations team run the processes, systems, communications, and reporting that make Manhattan’s partner programs easy to execute and scale. The successful candidate will work closely with partner engagement directors and partners to keep partner initiatives moving, ensure information is accurate, and create a consistent experience for partners. Achievements ABA Therapy is seeking a family-focused coordinator to guide prospective families through intake and build local referral relationships across Atlanta. This in-person role combines timely inquiry follow-up, intake coordination, accurate records, and community outreach.

**What you’ll do**

* Connect with prospective families by phone, email, and text; explain services and guide them through screening, records collection, insurance review, and assessment coordination.
* Follow up promptly, track each inquiry and next step, and keep accurate lead source, contact, and status records in company systems.
* Gather and organize intake information, identify missing items, and coordinate clear handoffs with clinical, authorization, and operations teammates.
* Build relationships with Atlanta-area schools, pediatric and therapy providers, family organizations, and other community partners.
* Represent Achievements at local resource fairs, school events, and partner visits; prepare materials, engage families, record leads, and support timely follow-up.
* Help plan outreach activities and share recurring family questions and community needs with the team.
* Protect confidential information and follow company privacy, documentation, and communication procedures.

**What we’re looking for**

* At least one year of experience in customer service, healthcare administration, intake, care coordination, community outreach, or a related role is preferred.
* Warm, clear communication, strong organization and follow-through and comfort managing several inquiries and deadlines at once.
* Comfort with email, calendars, spreadsheets, and web-based record systems, with the ability to learn company platforms and workflows.
* Ability to work in person in the Atlanta area and travel locally for partner visits and events. A valid driver’s license and reliable transportation are required for local travel.
* Flexibility to attend occasional evening or weekend events, scheduled in advance when possible.

**Helpful experience**

* ABA, autism services, behavioral health, or another family-centered healthcare setting; familiarity with Atlanta community partners; or CRM experience.

**Work setting and schedule**  
This is a full-time, in-person position based in the Atlanta area. The role includes local travel and occasional community events outside standard business hours.

**About Achievements ABA Therapy**  
We provide applied behavior analysis services to children and families, helping families understand their options, and coordinate services with care, communication, and respect.

jobs.description:
Description:

**ABOUT PROCURE ANALYTICS**

Procure Analytics (PA) is the leading tech-enabled group purchasing organization for MRO, Packaging, and Freight, leveraging $2.5B+ in buying power to deliver up-front and ongoing savings for 1,000+ member companies ranging from mid-size manufacturers to Fortune 500 corporations. Headquartered in Atlanta and owned by Genstar Capital, PA is in an aggressive growth phase with a rapidly expanding Packaging program.

PA serves as a strategic extension of our members' procurement organizations — driving adoption, managing supplier relationships, and delivering measurable, documented value at scale.

**The Packaging Program Today:** The Packaging program is one of PA's fastest-growing categories. With strong momentum and interest from our membership, we are building the team to ensure we stay ahead of the curve and exceed member expectations.

**THE ROLE**

As a Packaging Member Advisor, you will own a defined portfolio of packaging member accounts spanning a broad range of industries. Your members will range from independent companies to private equity-backed organizations and consulting relationships, reflecting the diversity of PA's membership base. You will serve as the primary point of contact for your members and a key driver of program adoption, realized value and impactful business outcomes. You will report to the Director of Packaging & Logistics and work in close partnership with others on the Packaging & Logistics team.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Manage a defined portfolio of packaging member accounts with full accountability for engagement, retention, and delivered value.
* Develop deep knowledge of each member's organization structure, procurement contacts, site operations, packaging spend profile, and strategic priorities.
* Maintain a 3-wide, 3-deep relationship architecture — building relationships across procurement, operations, and finance at C-suite, director, and site manager levels.
* Lead standardized Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) covering spend consolidated, savings delivered, opportunities identified, and forward-looking member needs.
* Identify and execute packaging optimization opportunities with our supplier partners, including SKU consolidation, packaging rationalization, vendor switching, and adoption tracking.
* Build strong working relationships with PA's packaging supplier partners to identify member-specific optimization levers.
* Utilize technology tools including PowerBI, Salesforce, Trumpet, AI, and PA proprietary software to document member interactions, track opportunity pipelines, and highlight risks.
* Support new member onboarding by participating in implementation handoffs and ensuring a seamless transition from the implementation process.

Requirements:

**Experience & Background**

* 3–5 years of experience in packaging, logistics, or supply chain account management — you have owned a book of business and been accountable for results.
* Direct experience working with or selling into manufacturing, industrial, or CPG companies; you understand how procurement decisions are made at complex organizations.
* Comfort navigating multi-stakeholder environments — you can operate effectively at the C-suite level and the site floor with equal ease.
* Demonstrated track record of building proactive client relationships, not reactive ones; you have examples of identifying and acting on opportunities before customers asked.
* Prior experience with PE-backed companies is a plus — you understand how private equity ownership shapes procurement priorities and decision timelines.
* Exposure to packaging distribution, manufacturing, or GPO/indirect spend environments (Uline, Veritiv, 48Forty, Shorr, or similar) is preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Analytical fluency: you are comfortable in Salesforce, Excel, and data tools — you use data to manage your accounts proactively, not reactively.
* Strong project management instincts: you can run a QBR, manage an optimization initiative, track deliverables, and hold suppliers and members accountable to commitments.
* Clear, confident communicator — written, verbal, and in presentations. You do not over-explain; you drive to decisions.
* Entrepreneurial mindset: you bring a sense of ownership and urgency to your work. You do not wait to be told what to do.
* Collaborative teammate: you escalate intelligently, share knowledge freely, and make the people around you better.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree from a competitive program required. Strong academic performance.
* MBA or advanced degree is a plus, but track record and results matter more.

**BENEFITS**

* Competitive compensation package
* Company subsidized medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) match
* Employee Assistance Program
* State-of-the-art, tech-enabled office near the Battery (Home of the Atlanta Braves)
* Flexible / hybrid work culture

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Headquartered in Glen Mills, Pennsylvania, New Carbon Company dba Golden Waffles is the largest supplier of waffle irons and waffle mix to the hospitality and foodservice industry. The Company provides a comprehensive turnkey waffle program consisting of mixes, toppings, and flavorings along with waffle iron equipment and related maintenance to over 40,000 customer locations throughout North America and the rest of the world. The Company's renowned irons and mixes have been used in leading restaurants, hotels, colleges, corporate environments, and theme parks for over 85 years.

As a complete B2B2C solution provider for the waffle category, the Company enables customers the ability to offer their guests a consistently high-quality, delicious product at high margins without the typical obstacles associated with serving waffles. Golden Waffles’ well-established geographic footprint provides coast to coast coverage in the U.S. and a global distribution partner network that can service customers across the U.S. and in ~45 countries.

Golden Waffles employs ~270 associates with a geographically dispersed route delivery team of ~115. Over 80 distribution centers are located across the United States along with a waffle iron manufacturing and refurbishment center in South Bend, Indiana to ensure prompt distribution to all customers.

**Job Summary**

The Business Development Representative is responsible for creating and executing market growth strategies - identifying new business opportunities, expanding into new markets, and maximizing sales within the assigned territory. The Business Development Representative is a proactive sales professional with a strong entrepreneurial spirit and a proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**New Business Opportunities in Assigned Territory:**

* Partner with foodservice operators (restaurants, hotels, institutions) to grow waffle program sales and menu penetration
* Use your hospitality/foodservice network to open and expand accounts — from independents to multi-unit chains; Lead negotiations and close deals to secure new business opportunities.
* Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve company goals and targets.
* Collaborate with marketing and product teams to shape promotional strategies that strengthen operator success
* Present and demonstrate company products and services to prospective customers within the assigned territory.
* Negotiate contracts and close sales deals to meet revenue targets.
* Provide regular reporting on sales activities, pipeline status, and market trends to management.
* Plan and execute the installation of all new accounts ensuring a seamless new customer experience from start to finish.
* Coordinate new account installation for large accounts with the local route sales representative and the customer service team.

**Partnership Development:**

Build and manage strategic relationships with foodservice distributors (broadline and regional[AD1] ), operator groups, and key channel partners to drive menu placement, distribution compliance, and volume growth within the territory. Develop trusted, long-term relationships with restaurant operators, chefs, and multi-unit decision-makers by acting as a consultative partner focused on menu profitability, product performance, and operational ease.

**Revenue Growth:**

* Drive revenue growth by developing and executing plans to increase sales and market share.
* Monitor and analyze sales performance, providing regular reports and insights to senior leadership.
* Identify and address any barriers to growth, implementing corrective actions as needed.

**Brand Representation:**

* Represent Golden Waffles at industry events, conferences, and trade shows.
* Act as a brand ambassador, promoting our values and vision to external audiences.

**Position Requirements**

* 2–5+ yrs experience in foodservice sales, wholesale distribution, restaurant supply, or CPG[AD2] route/business development
* Deep understanding of foodservice operators, buyers, and menu cycles
* Proven consultative sales track record with measurable results
* Evaluate inbound and outbound lead data to rank and pursue high-value foodservice accounts, ensuring time and resources are focused on opportunities with the highest likelihood of conversion and long-term revenue.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and CRM software (e.g., Salesforce).
* Willingness to travel within the designated territory as required.

VieMed Healthcare is the largest independent specialized provider of non-invasive ventilation (NIV) in the US home respiratory health care industry. Gallagher Security is a global technology leader trusted by organizations to protect people, assets, and operations in complex environments. We’re looking for an energetic Sales Development Representative who enjoys connecting with prospective customers, generating demand, and creating opportunities that support our continued growth.

**The Opportunity**

As an SDR, you will engage in our lead generation strategy that focuses on research, outreach, prospecting, outbound demand generation, inbound, and lead qualification via all our social media and market intelligence platforms. This position will help turn leads into qualified opportunities by partnering with marketing and sales to create and execute on program and outbound lead generation campaigns. This will be accomplished by conducting a mix of communication tactics such as email and outbound calls, with the ultimate goal of uncovering new or existing sales leads as well as identifying and generating sales opportunities through both inbound and outbound calling activities.

Reporting to the Sales Development Team Lead, you’ll work cross functionally with sales, marketing, and engineering, and as one of the first people a prospect speaks with, you’ll set the tone for the sales cycle that follows.

This is a hybrid role, with an expected 2–3 days per week in our Canton office and the remainder working from home. Travel is minimal.

**What You’ll Do**

* Follow up on inbound marketing leads and qualify interest through phone and email conversations, giving prospects the right information at the right time.

* Build target prospect lists, penetrate key accounts, and cold call prospects sourced from a range of channels.

* Profile strategic accounts, identify key decision makers, and research business requirements to start the sales cycle.

* Run discovery and qualification calls and deliver high level, solution oriented presentations on Gallagher products and services.

* Understand each prospect’s needs and tailor your outreach to suit.

* Nurture leads until they’re ready to speak with a Business Development Manager or Regional Sales Manager, then set appointments, schedule on-site demos, and hand off qualified opportunities.

* Drive attendance at webinars and live seminars and set meetings for conferences.

* Keep accurate prospect, activity, and lead qualification records in our CRM to ensure strong follow through.

* Share feedback and new ideas to continually improve our sales development process.

* Build your knowledge of the access control, perimeter protection, and intrusion detection markets, and clearly articulate the value Gallagher Security brings.

* Shadow Business Development Managers and, when needed, travel with Outside Sales to meet in-region partners and end users.

**What You’ll Bring**

You’re a confident, energetic communicator who enjoys starting conversations, thinks outside the box, and brings real tenacity to reaching your goals.

* 2+ years of successful experience in inside sales, demand generation, telemarketing, and/or customer service.

* A four year college degree from an accredited institution, or equivalent experience; a bachelor’s degree in business or a related area is preferred.

* Demonstrated success in prospecting and experience using CRM systems; experience with sales outreach platforms is a plus.

* Excellent written and verbal communication, strong active listening, emotional intelligence, and a positive, energetic phone presence.

* The ability to manage multiple requests and priorities at once while achieving goals for your territory or accounts.

* A self-motivated approach and sense of urgency. You act without waiting to be told and work well under pressure.

* A team player mindset, with the flexibility to work independently and collaborate with a distributed sales team in a fast paced, changing environment.

* High integrity, a strong work ethic, and a commitment to building a successful company.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

**What We Offer**

* Career development opportunities, including the chance to learn from experienced sales professionals and build skills for future advancement.

* A collaborative, cross functional environment where your ideas and contributions can help improve our sales approach.

* The opportunity to represent a respected global security technology company and contribute directly to regional growth.

Chicago, Illinois, United States Category Customer Success, Services, & Support

  

Job description

At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.
  
  
When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

**Account Manager**

  

**Why We Have This Role**

As a Sr Account Manager on our Safety Delivery Team, you will play a central role in delivering exceptional support and implementation services to healthcare clients. You will serve as a primary client advocate, managing support requests, assisting with implementations, and leveraging deep safety product knowledge to troubleshoot platform issues and advise healthcare organizations on best practices. A key responsibility includes leading client implementations into our Patient Safety Organization (PSO), ensuring technical integrations and operational requirements are fully achieved. If you are passionate about technology-driven healthcare transformation, driving user adoption, and improving patient safety outcomes, this role is for you.

  

**How You’ll Find Success**

* **Client Advocacy & Service Mindset:** Passionately advocates for healthcare clients, maintaining high engagement and delivering timely, high-quality resolutions.

* **Technical & Platform Troubleshooting:** Efficiently diagnoses, investigates, and resolves complex user, technical, and platform-related support tickets.

* **Implementation & PSO Guidance:** Seamlessly leads clients through post-go-live adoption and specialized implementation programs, such as Patient Safety Organization (PSO) setups.

* **Cross-Functional Partner:** Collaborates effectively with Delivery, Product Management, and Engineering teams to voice client needs and continuous software improvements.

* **Detail & Deadline Management:** Comfortably manages multiple simultaneous projects, client accounts, and deadlines with strong organizational skills.
  

  

**How You’ll Grow**

* Expand your expertise in healthcare SaaS platforms, patient safety protocols, incident reporting workflows, and PSO compliance framework operations.

* Build strong cross-functional exposure by working directly with Delivery, Product Management, and Engineering teams.

* Enhance your client enablement and instructional design skills by developing client-facing training programs and best-practice documentation.

* Further develop leadership capabilities in strategic client management and healthcare technology execution.
  

  

**Things You’ll Do**

* **Manage Client Support & Escalations:** Efficiently resolve client support tickets for safety platforms and partner with technical teams on escalated issues.

* **Lead PSO Implementations:** Serve as the primary point of contact for onboarding clients into the Patient Safety Organization (PSO), ensuring complete alignment with system integrations and compliance standards.

* **Drive Platform Adoption & Training:** Deliver client training sessions and maintain updated training resources to empower user self-sufficiency and platform utilization.

* **Advocate for Client Needs:** Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to translate client workflow needs into product optimizations.

* **Advise on Safety Workflows:** Recommend platform features and workflows that align with client safety goals, incident reporting needs, and compliance standards.
  

  

**What We’re Looking For On Your Resume**

* **3+ years** of client-facing experience in customer service, healthcare, or project management (ideally within Healthcare SaaS or digital health technology).

* Proven experience supporting or implementing software platforms, user training, or customer onboarding.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent 4-year college program.

* Strong computer proficiency including Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) with higher-level Excel skills preferred.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong analytical and organizational capabilities.
  

  

**What You Should Know About This Team**

* **Mission-Driven Work:** Our team is dedicated to improving healthcare outcomes and patient safety through innovative technology solutions.

* **Client-Centric & Collaborative:** We work closely with internal product and engineering teams to ensure our clients' voices drive ongoing platform improvements.

* **Fast-Paced & Dynamic:** We manage multi-faceted projects and client inquiries in a high-energy, collaborative environment.

* **Focus on Growth & Empowerment:** We place strong emphasis on continuous product education, team collaboration, and client success enablement.
  

  

**Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits**

* **Comprehensive Health & Wellness Coverage:** Premium health, dental, and vision packages for team members and dependents.

You can’t get enough social, whether it’s following the top foodie influencers, keeping up with the latest digital trends or trying the latest TikTok trend. You are the account dynamo, helping meet client goals by crafting a social media voice and channeling brand sentiment to build authentic, relevant, interactive conversations and relationships. A proverbial eager beaver, you meet or beat deadlines, stay ahead of trends and always look for a new way to skin a cat. You like to go big – because going home isn’t an option. You’re a problem solver, creative thinker and value the relationships you’ve built with influencers and trendsetters. A Social Media Manager for bread & Butter should be thoughtful, creative, a strong writer, possess an almost obsessive attention to detail and is the first to get in the mix when helping means the chance to learn more.  
  
***Available Opportunity:***  
A Social Media Manager for bread & Butter is responsible for managing the online platforms of clients and influencer programming on a daily basis. The Social Media Manager will serve as a representative of the company and works in tandem with the PR, Creative, and Digital Marketing Teams.  
  
***Here’s What We Need:***

* Located in Washington, D.C. or Park City, UT
* 3-5 years of full-time, post-undergraduate relevant experience in social media management and influencer marketing, preferably with agency vs. in-house
* BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience
* Appreciates the art of telling the client story through influencer partnerships and key messaging
* A passion for building and cultivating relationships with influencers in the digital space, ranging from Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube and blog content creators
* Extensive knowledge of Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, YouTube and other relevant social media networks.
* Experience with launching social campaigns for hotels, restaurants, food personalities and/or CPG food and beverage brands.
* Background in creative development, social media analytics tools, and campaign analysis.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, prioritizing and handling multiple projects.
* Ability to peer and self-edit writing quickly, turning around social media posts in real time.
* Ability to identify strategic and creative social media collaborations, takeovers and promotions for brands and lead through steps to execute.
* Help develop and strategize creative influencer partnerships and alliances that keep clients ahead of the curve.
* Ability to exercise sound judgement, responding to consumers and guests within a brand’s voice during daily community management practices.
* Media junkie - there’s no such thing as reading/watching too much. Bonus points for pop culture acumen.
* Love of a fast-paced environment and the satisfaction of a busy yet productive day.
* Flexibility and a desire for endless possibilities. b&B is a dynamic, ever-evolving company that thinks beyond black and white.
* Excitement for growth, new ideas, new ways of doing things and a place you’re excited to call home. Say yes!

  
***Working Conditions***  
On the whole, this is a hybrid, office-based role. A Social Media Manager will spend time in meetings and briefings. Occasional travel might be required for client visits and planning. This position is considered sedentary to light work, and employees are not required to lift or move heavy objects. Although a Social Media Manager's commitment will tend to be standard office hours, deadlines or the demands of a client may see the Manager working nights or weekends to ensure continued success. Must be authorized to work in the US.  
  
***Having Our Cake & Eating it too:***

* Generous paid time off
* Paid sick/personal time
* Birthday off (because who wants to work on their special day!)
* Endless summer Fridays (half-days year 'round baby)
* Flexible, hybrid schedule
* Work from any b&B office when you're in town
* Medical and dental + dependents
* Extended benefits (vision, life, disability, EAP)
* Generous maternity and family planning leave
* 3% contribution to 401k regardless of participation
* Cell phone reimbursement
* New business bonuses
* Employee referral bonus
* Weekly Wine Wednesdays (cheers with your local team!)
* Robust training program
* Mentorship program
* Local love (yearly giveback initiative)

  
***Compensation:***  
The annual salary range for this role is $65,000 to $75,000.

jobs.title: Sales Representative (Chicago)
jobs.description:
**What is Exoticca?**

Exoticca is a pioneering online travel agency that has revolutionized the conception, production, and e-commerce of long-distance dream trips. At the core of Exoticca's brand equity is the commitment to "creating life milestones." We believe in delivering best-value trips, exploring unique destinations, curating extraordinary travel experiences, and demonstrating genuine care for both our customers and the planet.  
  
We are a professional, dynamic, multicultural team in rapid international growth, seeking new partners to help us create the best and most forward-thinking travel company of our generation.

**What do we do?**

Our B2B Sales Team is responsible for developing and growing Exoticca's network of Travel Advisors and agency partners across North America. Through a combination of field sales, training, account activation and relationship management, the team helps Travel Advisors discover Exoticca, understand our product and ultimately grow their business with us.

**What will you do?**  
The Sales Representative (B2B) is a field-based sales role focused on developing and growing Exoticca's Tier 2 and Tier 3 agency accounts (Silver & Bronze) within an assigned territory. This is a hands-on, execution-focused position with a strong emphasis on in-person agency visits, account activation and high-frequency market coverage.

You will work closely with the Business Development Managers and the broader B2B Sales Team to ensure that our Silver and Bronze accounts receive regular commercial attention, product education and support, helping them increase their engagement and bookings with Exoticca.

**Your main responsibilities will include:**  

* Visit Travel Agencies regularly across the assigned territory, maintaining a consistent and high-frequency field presence.
* Manage and develop a portfolio primarily composed of Silver and Bronze account (Tier 2 & Tier 3) within Exoticca's Loyalty Program.
* Build strong relationships with Travel Advisors and agency teams, becoming their day-to-day commercial point of contact.
* Activate and grow existing accounts, helping Travel Advisors move from registration to first booking and from occasional to more frequent production.
* Identify opportunities to reactivate dormant and low-producing accounts.
* Educate Travel Advisors on Exoticca's destinations, products, promotions, booking tools and Loyalty Program.
* Conduct in-person product presentations, agency trainings and webinars.
* Identify potential new agency partners and support the acquisition and activation of new accounts.
* Promote group opportunities and identify potential group business within the assigned portfolio.
* Attend relevant trade shows, industry events, conferences and FAM trips when required.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date information on account activity, visits and commercial opportunities in CRM.
* Work closely with Business Development Managers to identify accounts with significant growth potential that may require additional commercial support.
* Meet agreed activity and performance KPIs, including agency visits, account activation, booking activity and portfolio development.

The emphasis on frequent field coverage and a recurring visit pattern is intentional: the Sales Representative role is designed to provide more intensive market coverage than the more senior BDM structure.

 **Requirements**  

* 1–2 years of experience in sales, business development, account management on the travel industry.
* Experience within the travel industry is preferred, but we are also open to candidates with strong sales potential and a genuine interest in travel.
* Strong commercial mindset and enthusiasm for developing customer relationships.
* Comfortable spending a significant amount of time in the field visiting Trave Agencies.
* Self-motivated and comfortable managing a territory and daily visit schedule independently.
* Strong communication, interpersonal and presentation skills.
* Comfortable conducting small group presentations, product training and webinars.
* Organized and disciplined in managing follow-ups and CRM activity.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-changing and international environment.
* Willingness to learn, receive hands-on coaching and develop within the organization.
* Availability to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory and occasionally attend industry events and FAM trips.
* Fluency in Spanish is a plus.

  
**Benefits**  

* Competitive compensation package in line with job responsibilities and experience.
* Travel packages at reduced prices!
* English/Spanish lesson, bi-annual company parties.
* Referral bonus, if you bring people as talented as you.
* And last but not least, becoming part of a fun and motivated multicultural team at an agile and rapid growing organization!

Join Exoticca and play a pivotal role in creating life milestones through unforgettable travel experiences! This is your opportunity to shape the future of a dynamic and innovative travel brand on a global scale.

*Exoticca is an equal opportunity employer. Diversity and inclusiveness are our core. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under European, country, or local law.*
