jobs.title: Territory Sales Representative - Entry Level / Full Time
jobs.description:
Territory Sales Representative – Entry Level / Full Time
  
  
Chicago North Territory
  
  
Break Into Pharmaceutical Sales with Pivya® at ImpactBio supporting Alembic Therapeutics
  
  
Do you have work experience that demonstrates drive, energy, and transferable skills that will lead to being a strong salesperson?
  
If you are looking to launch a career in pharmaceutical sales, this is your opportunity!
  
  
Alembic Therapeutics, in partnership with ImpactBio, is launching Pivya®, an FDA-approved oral antibiotic for uncomplicated urinary tract infections (uUTIs). With over 40 years of success in Sweden, Pivya® is now entering the U.S. market—and we’re building a high-performance sales team to support this launch.
  
  
As a Territory Sales Representative, you don’t need prior pharmaceutical sales experience—we’re looking for motivated, coachable individuals who are eager to learn, follow a proven sales model, and build a long-term career in the industry. You’ll receive the training, tools, and mentorship needed to succeed while gaining real-world experience calling on healthcare providers.
  
  
This full-time role is with ImpactBio, a premier commercial partner in Life Sciences, with the potential to transition to Alembic Therapeutics based on strong performance.
  
View Openings & Apply Here Job Openings - ImpactBio
  
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
This is more than a sales job—it’s a career entry point into pharmaceutical sales. You’ll be part of a national product launch, gaining experience in a highly competitive industry while developing the skills and discipline needed to grow your career.
  
  
**We’re looking for individuals who are:**  

* Hungry to succeed
* Open to coaching and feedback
* Willing to follow a structured plan
* Ready to put in the work to build something meaningful

If that sounds like you, we’ll teach you the rest.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Promote Pivya® to healthcare providers within your assigned territory
* Learn and execute a structured sales process and messaging strategy
* Build relationships with physicians, nurses, and office staff
* Consistently apply training and coaching in the field
* Develop and execute territory plans to achieve sales goals
* Provide timely updates, insights, and field feedback to leadership
* Maintain full compliance with all company and industry regulations

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required
* 1–3 years of experience meeting or exceeding goals/metrics (some sales experience would be helpful, B2B sales, Pharma sales, outside sales, customer facing)
* A strong desire to break into pharmaceutical or healthcare sales
* Proven work ethic and demonstrated a track record of going above and beyond to succeed
* Coachability—someone who takes direction well and applies feedback quickly
* High level of motivation, resilience, and accountability
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently while following a defined sales plan
* Willingness to travel extensively within territory
* Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record

Pharmaceutical experience is not required—drive, attitude, and willingness to learn are.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  

* Competitive base salary with a generous performance-based incentive plan
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
* Car allowance & mileage reimbursement
* 401K plan with company match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Structured training program designed to help you break into and succeed in pharmaceutical sales
* Ongoing mentorship and field coaching
* A clear path for career growth and advancement
* The chance to be part of a major U.S. product launch

About Alembic Therapeutics
  
  
Alembic Therapeutics LLC, a U.S. subsidiary of Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., is committed to delivering high-quality, patient-focused branded pharmaceuticals. Our mission is to bring innovative, reliable medicines to the U.S. market while upholding the highest standards of safety, efficacy, and quality.
  
  
About ImpactBio
  
  
At ImpactBio, we build and launch commercial teams with a focus on performance, development, and long-term success. We’re known for investing in our people and creating opportunities for driven individuals to grow into high-performing professionals in the life sciences industry.
  
  
Apply Now
  
  
View Openings & Apply Here Job Openings - ImpactBio
  
  
ImpactBio is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)
  
  
We appreciate your interest in our company, however; only candidates meeting qualifications will be considered.

jobs.title: Associate Sales Representative - Chicago - Surgical Technologies
jobs.description:
### **Why join Stryker?**

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award-winning culture.  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

### **Job description**

We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine! We are proud to offer you 12 paid holidays annually. For an overview of our benefits and time off, please follow this link to learn more:US Stryker employee benefits.

**Associate Sales Representative**

Begin your career in medical device sales with a hands-on role supporting healthcare professionals and innovative technologies that help improve patient care. As an Associate Sales Representative, you will partner with an experienced Sales Representative(s) to support customer accounts, assist with clinical procedures, and contribute to territory growth. This field-based position provides exposure to sales, clinical environments, and account management while building a foundation for long-term career development.

**About the Business:**

**Surgical Technologies (ST)**  
Our Surgical Technologies portfolio includes operating room equipment, visualization systems, and safety-focused technologies that support efficiency and improve outcomes.  
**ST Product Portfolio:** Stryker | Surgical Technologies

**What You Will Do**

* Support territory growth by assisting with sales activities, account management, and customer engagement across assigned territory.
* Prepare for and support product evaluations, clinical procedures, and customer interactions across operating room, office-based, and procedural care settings.
* Provide product support and education to surgeons, nurses, clinicians, and healthcare staff to help ensure appropriate product use and a positive customer experience.
* Manage inventory levels, product availability, and case preparation activities within the territory.
* Track sales and territory activities, maintain account information, and support reporting requirements.
* Partner with the Sales Representative(s) to identify business opportunities and support account development initiatives.
* Participate in product training and apply technical and clinical knowledge to support customer education and engagement.

**What You Will Need**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel throughout the assigned territory including but not limited to customer sites, healthcare facilities, and business meetings.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Minimum 1 year of experience in outside sales, field sales, business development, account management, customer success, territory management, or a customer-facing role.
* Experience managing responsibilities through work experience, athletics, academic programs, military service, or leadership activities.
* Exposure to medical device, healthcare, clinical, life sciences, business-to-business sales, or other performance-driven environments.
* Experience supporting customers in a fast-paced, team-based environment.

**What We Offer**

At Stryker, you’ll be part of a collaborative, high-performing team focused on making an impact for our customers and patients. We offer a dynamic environment with strong opportunities for growth and long-term career development within a global leader in medical technology. If you’re looking for a role where you can build meaningful relationships, grow your territory, and support innovative surgical technologies in the field, we’d welcome the opportunity to connect.

$77,000 salary and may be eligible to earn a bonus + benefits

Health benefits include: Medical and prescription drug insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, critical illness insurance, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, personalized healthcare support, wellbeing program and tobacco cessation program. Financial benefits include: Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), basic life and AD&D insurance, and short-term disability insurance. Stryker offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually. Depending on customer requirements employees and new hires in sales and field roles that require access to customer accounts as a function of the job may be required to obtain various vaccinations as an essential function of their role.

Generac has an exciting entry level Sales Development Representative position! The Sales Development Representative is responsible for a territory where they are accountable to grow POS sales at the store level. This role educates store associates on Generac’s product lines, answers questions from consumers, and pro’s buying the company’s products and providing support to the dealer channel for specific retail customers’ SF&I programs. * Wisconsin

* Valid driver’s license with the ability to travel locally up to 75% of the time

* Effective presentation skills for small and large groups
* Strong problem-solving skills
* Ability to work independently
* Ability to make decisions in the best interest of the customer and company
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize activities according to importance and urgency
* Ability to react well under pressure
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and familiarity with CRM software.
* Willingness to travel frequently within the designated region

**Preferred Job Requirements**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, or Accounting.

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities**

* Highly motivated with excellent communication, presentation, and training abilities. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Experience using CRM like salesforce
* Ability to build a weekly schedule

jobs.title: Operations Associate - Material Handler / Driver / Yard Helper / Coordinator
jobs.description:
Quality, service, and integrity are the core values that founded Peerless Fence in 1961. While we have grown from our modest beginnings in Villa Park, IL as subcontractors installing commercial chain link fences, we continue to deliver on this promise today.

We are growing fast while changing and evolving every day – and we are seeking high energy, high initiative, adaptable individuals to grow with our company. We thrive on change and our ability to pivot quickly. Our employees are held to a high standard and are an extremely important part of our team.

We are looking for a candidate who works well in a fast-paced environment, has experience in the construction or service industries, and enjoys working outdoors throughout the year. Although we're a seasonal business, we install and service our customers year round. In this role, you will be prepping materials and staging hundreds of projects for success each season. You play a critical role in setting up our crews for success and our customers for a top-notch experience working with our company. It's critical that the person in this role is attentive to detail, accurate, diligent in following our internal processes and protocols, and quick on their feet to problem-solve when needed. Experience working with computers or an order database is important to long-term success in this role. We are an organization built on safety and doing what's right. Candidates should have a positive driving record and a commitment to prioritizing safe work habits. Does this sound like you? We hope you apply!

**Position Overview**  
The Operations Associate position is responsible for supporting efficient, accurate, and organized operations in our yard facility. This position is responsible for staging material pick ups, completing associated paperwork and making local deliveries among other duties in the yard and office. Tis role is primarily focused on the following objectives:

* Support efficient daily operations in shop and yard facilities
* Stage and deliver material with accuracy
* Follow production schedule to complete orders on time

**Role and Responsibilities**

* Prepare, stage, and load material required for next day’s project installations
* Unload material from delivery trucks
* Drive material to work sites or between operational facilities as needed

**Required Skills**

* Welding or fabrication experience
* A self-starter with a strong work ethic
* Ability to prioritize tasks
* Maintain an organized work environment
* Maintain a current and valid driver’s license
* Prioritize safety measures and follow safety protocols
* Capable of lifting up to 80 pounds
* Willingness and ability to work in all weather conditions
* Ability to communicate clearly, respectfully
* Basic math skills
* General computer skills

**Preferred Skills**

* Current and valid forklift certification
* Current and valid Class C license
* General construction skills

What credentials do you need? Proven high performance results, the right personality for our culture, and the perseverance to make the customer happy no matter how hard it gets. That is all.

**What We Offer**

Joining our team means becoming part of a growing organization that values its employees and invests in their future. Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive benefits package including paid holidays, PTO, medical, dental, vision, disability, and voluntary life benefits, plus a 401(k) plan with company match and immediate vesting eligibility beginning the first of the month after hire. Additional voluntary benefits include critical illness and accident coverage, identity theft protection, legal aid, and pet insurance.

###### **Why Join Us?**

If you enjoy building, improving, and solving problems in a fast-moving environment, you’ll likely thrive here. We’re looking for people who are adaptable, collaborative, and excited to grow alongside the business.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
fairlife, LLC is a Chicago-based nutrition company that creates great-tasting, nutrition-rich and dairy products to nourish consumers.

With over $3B in annual retail sales, fairlife's portfolio of delicious, lactose-free, real dairy products includes: **fairlife® ultra-filtered milk**; **Core Power®** High Protein Shakes, a sports nutrition drink to support post-workout recovery; **fairlife® nutrition plan™**, a nutrition shake to support the journey to better health.

A wholly owned subsidiary of The Coca-Cola company, fairlife, LLC has been recognized by both Fast Company and Nielsen for its industry leading innovation.

To learn more about fairlife and its complete line of products, please visit fairlife.com.

**Job Purpose**

The Executive Assistant will provide high-level administrative support to fairlife, LLC's Executive Leadership Team (ELT) by acting as a project manager of people: conducting meeting coordination, providing support to the executive's functional team, handling information requests, managing business-related event planning and coordination, and performing a wide variety of other administrative functions. An ideal candidate is responsive, thoughtful, self-directed, positive, and can communicate effectively and efficiently.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as a trusted business partner, managing time, priorities, and communication for the Chief Executive Officer (CEO),Chief Operating Officer (COO) and VP Public Affairs, Communications and Sustainability (PACS)
* Help manage calendar and meeting discipline: schedule, confirm attendance, and escalate when necessary to ensure participation.
* Coordinate logistics for meetings, events, and offsites (virtual and in-person), including catering, A/V, group activities and travel arrangements.
* Anticipate needs and act independently to resolve issues before they arise.
* Maintain strong follow-up routines with internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Partner with other Executive Assistants to align calendars and support cross-functional projects.
* Manage expense reports, coordinate invoices, memberships, registrations, and ad hoc projects with accuracy and timeliness.
* Build trust quickly with new stakeholders and maintain open communication.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve efficiency.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Agile communicator who professionally and confidently engages with senior leaders and pushes through conflict.
* Attention to detail in scheduling, documentation, and follow-up.
* Proactive relationship builder who anticipates needs.
* Ability to project manage executive priorities, ensuring meetings happen and decisions move forward.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years supporting top level executives in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
* Strong project management skills with experience coordinating complex events and initiatives.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel).
* Exceptional organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure.
* High level of discretion, professionalism, and judgment.
* Comfortable holding others accountable and influencing outcomes with tact.
* Flexible and adaptable to changing priorities and work styles.
* Ability to work primarily onsite with occasional travel.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Fearless communicator who thrives in dynamic environments.
* Skilled at anticipating needs and solving problems independently.
* Positive, resourceful, respectful and committed to building team culture.

**how fairlife nourishes you:**

At fairlife, we believe in better — and that includes how we support our people. We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits and wellbeing resources designed to support you physically, emotionally, socially, and financially, both in and out of work.

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, effective day one!
* Supplemental health plans (hospital indemnity, accident, and critical illness insurance)
* Paid Time Off to recharge and support work-life balance
* Paid parental leave & adoption assistance (up to $10,000)
* Parental support & family care benefits, including childcare resources and lactation support
* 401(k) to support retirement planning with up to 9% in employer match
* Wellness reimbursement (up to $500 for qualified wellbeing expenses)
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for emotional wellbeing and work-life support
* Company-paid life insurance and short-term disability
* Employer HSA funding (for HDHP participants)
* Tuition reimbursement (up to $10,000) and student loan repayment ($200/month)
* Learning & development programs to unlock your full potential
* Rewards & recognition, matching gifts, free product, and Business Resource Groups

fairlife's nour!sh program is designed to meet you where you are — supporting your individual wellbeing journey while enabling you to do your best work every day.

**position location:** Chicago, IL

**reports to**: VP, PACS

**travel requirements:** up to 20%

**exempt/nonexempt:** Exempt

We do not discriminate on the basis of* *race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. The Production Coordinator is responsible for maintaining accurate order information, organizing production projects, updating schedules, and facilitating communication between internal departments.

Working closely with the Operations Manager, Account Manager, and Production Manager, this person will help ensure that all project details, approvals, and requirements are properly documented and communicated before production begins.

Order Entry & Project Organization

General Operations Support

* Assist with local pickups, deliveries, and other errands as necessary.

Qualifications

* Experience in apparel manufacturing, screen printing, or garment decoration is a plus.
* Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong communication skills and ability to coordinate across departments.

**ABOUT GREYSTAR**

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com.

**JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY**

This role supports and assists the Community Manager in overseeing and managing the financial and operational facets of the community by completing accounting and bookkeeping tasks, preparing monthly close-out and financial reports, processing invoices for payment, collecting rent, fees, and other payments, completing bank deposits, dispositions, and account reconciliations, and using the property management software to record, track, and report on all financial workings of the community.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Property Type: Stabilized**

**Unit Count: 150**

**Schedule: Tuesday-Saturday; 9am - 6pm \*Subject to change depending on business needs**

**Requirements: 1-2 years of Leasing experience; Prior experience using Yardi, CRM - Preferred**

**Housing Discount: This position is eligible for a 20% housing discount**

* Completes the daily transactions and tasks related to the financial operation of the community by collecting and posting rent, fees, and other payments, preparing daily bank deposits and reconciling bank accounts, preparing financial reports, and processing invoices and payables.
* Operates the property management software (Yardi/OneSite) and completes transactions by entering all required fields correctly and by completing updates and back-ups to ensure the integrity of the system.
* Reviews resident files and accounting records to determine unpaid and/or late fees owed, communicates with residents regarding outstanding balances, implements procedures for collecting on delinquencies, and enforces the lease to maximize revenue.
* Reviews and submits invoices from vendors, contractors, and service providers for payment by reconciling work performed or products purchased, obtaining community manager approval, coding charges to appropriate Chart of Account codes, and managing communication between the vendor/contractor, accounting, and the client/owner as needed.
* Follows the Company’s established procedures related to evictions by following proper notice requirements, evicting residents, and representing the community as required in court hearings and eviction proceedings.
* Processes resident move-outs by reviewing lease terms and notice requirements, applying appropriate deposit and lease cancellation fees, if applicable, and processing the disposition in accordance with established procedures and legal requirements.
* Promotes resident satisfaction and retention by responding to complaints, questions, and requests in a timely manner, and taking appropriate action to resolve and address service issues.
* Acts as the on-site supervisor in the absence of the community manager by organizing and delegating daily work, coordinating maintenance and make-ready tasks with the maintenance supervisor, and managing the operation of the community in compliance with Company policies, procedures, and business practices.
* Assists in managing the client/owner relationship by meeting with the owners, conducting community tours, providing updates and information about the community’s performance, and responding to owner requests as needed.
* May assist and/or support leasing and marketing efforts by greeting prospective residents, gathering information about the prospect via the Guest Card, showing ready apartments and models, closing and obtaining the lease deposit, and assisting the prospective resident in completing the rental application and credit verification.
* For California Only: The Assistant Community Manager or Leasing Manager must review all completed move in files prior to submission to the Community Manager for review and approval.

**BASIC KNOWLEDGE & QUALIFICATIONS:**
-------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Communications, or related field from an accredited college or university is preferred.
* 1-3 years minimum of relevant experience in residence life and/or property management that demonstrates the application of community management, sales, marketing, and customer service background sufficient to assist in managing the day-to-day operations of an apartment community, resolve customer complaints and issues, complete financial records, documents, and reports, increase sales revenues, and coordinate the work of a team.
* Understanding of lease terms and lease enforcement, including collections.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Detail-oriented and self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as a collaborative member of a team.

**SPECIALIZED SKILLS:**
-----------------------

* Incumbents must have all licenses and/or certifications as required by State and Local jurisdictions.
* Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to drive a golf cart on property.
* Demonstrated proficiency in Internet, word processing, spreadsheet, and database management programs in order to complete required reports and documents.
* Strong proficiency in using property management software (Yardi, OneSite, Entrata, etc.).

**TRAVEL / PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

new_jobs.title: AI-First Administrative Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**About Elite Open School**

Since 1987, Elite Education Group has trained generations of students and families worldwide to achieve their American education dreams. Elite Open School, founded in Southern California in 2015, provides accredited blended education for middle and high school students in the U.S. and abroad. EOS is accredited by both WASC and Cognia, offering UC-approved courses and College Board-approved APs.

**The Role: Why AI-First?**

This is not a traditional administrative role. We are looking for someone who sees every repetitive task as a problem to solve with AI. Your primary mission is to **reduce complexity, time, cost, and burden** across school operations by identifying, building, and maintaining AI-powered workflows and automations. You will be a part of the administrative foundation of our school and you will help us do it smarter, faster, and more efficiently than before.

We want you to figure out how to leverage the latest AI tools, integrations, and automations so that manual processes become automated pipelines, communication becomes streamlined, and our team can focus on what matters most: our students and their families.

**Core ResponsibilitiesAI Workflow Design & Automation**

* Audit existing administrative processes and identify opportunities for AI automation and augmentation
* Research, evaluate, and implement AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Zapier, Make, Notion AI, Google AI features) to streamline school operations
* Build and maintain automated workflows for enrollment processing, student registration, data entry, withdrawals, and records management
* Design integrations between school systems (SIS, LMS, email, Slack, Google Workspace) to eliminate manual data transfer and reduce errors
* Create AI-assisted templates, auto-responses, and smart routing for common inquiries across email, Slack, and phone
* Document all automations and workflows so they are reproducible, trainable, and scalable

**School Administration (AI-Augmented)**

* Manage student information and data across school systems—using AI to flag inconsistencies, automate updates, and generate reports
* Handle Elite Open School communications—leveraging AI drafting, summarization, and prioritization tools
* Maintain thorough knowledge of EOS services and proactively surface relevant information to team members using AI-powered knowledge bases or internal chatbots
* Support team projects by responding to requests for assistance, using AI to accelerate research, document creation, and task coordination
* Oversee onboarding documentation and internal training materials—keeping them current and accessible, ideally through AI-generated or AI-updated resources
* Provide general administrative and clerical support, continuously seeking ways to automate or semi-automate recurring tasks

**Continuous Improvement & Reporting**

* Track time and cost savings generated by AI implementations and report on ROI to leadership
* Stay current on emerging AI tools, trends, and best practices relevant to education administration and edtech
* Proactively propose new automations and process improvements on a monthly basis
* Train team members on new AI tools and workflows as they are deployed

**Ideal Candidate ProfileMindset & Disposition**

* AI-curious and proactive—you experiment with new tools before being asked to
* Growth mindset with a bias toward action and iteration
* Comfort with ambiguity; you can figure things out without a playbook
* Patience, sincerity, and compassion in student- and family-facing interactions
* Genuine interest in growing within education and/or the edtech industry

**Skills & Capabilities**

* Demonstrated ability to use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar) for real work tasks—not just casual use
* Experience with or willingness to quickly learn workflow automation platforms (Zapier, Make/Integromat, Power Automate, or similar)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong self-organization and attention to detail
* Ability to present oneself professionally and thrive in a fast-paced environment
* Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, and common SaaS tools
* Strong familiarity with administrative functions and server management in Discord

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher
* US work authorization required
* Portfolio, write-up, or demo of a workflow or process you’ve automated or improved using AI

**Career Foundations & Growth Tracks**

While this is an entry-level role, we place a strong emphasis on internal promotion and long-term growth. The ideal career progression moves from this role into supervising future AI-First Admin Coordinators, with potential advancement toward school leadership and school board governance positions. Elite works with each employee to ensure personal development, diverse experiences, and notable growth in the following areas:

* AI Operations & Process Engineering
* Management – Hiring, Training, Team Development
* Local or Regional Marketing
* Business or Brand Development – New Campus Startup or Established Campus Development
* Seminars and Public Speaking
* Public or International School Relations
* International Project Coordination
* Technology – AI Implementation, EdTech Development, Google Services, Systems Integration

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Full-Time: $35,000 – $45,000 annually
* Monthly Salary with Structured Bonuses
* Health Care
* Career Building Foundation
* Best Company Culture and Teamwork

**More About Elite Open School**

We aim to prepare students for the 4th Industrial Revolution. The acceleration in AI, robotics, biotech, and automation demands that we equip students with creativity, advanced communication, critical thinking, and cognitive flexibility. Elite Open School is uniquely “Open” to creativity-based education through multilingual campuses, digital and adaptive curriculum, individualized pacing, and unlimited experiential learning opportunities.

You’ll make strategic recommendations to new and existing customers to help prevent pests, uphold quality and safety, and satisfy their regulatory standards. You’ll solve problems and build trusted relationships as an essential partner protecting their business. Adept at listening to needs and clearly explaining practical solutions, you can win over customers with confidence and care.

**We Offer…**

* Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave
* Employee discounts, tuition reimbursement, dependent scholarship awards

* You have a service-oriented mindset that leads you to build loyalty and trust with customers

new_jobs.description:
Position Information

**Job Title**

Program Coordinator - CalWORKs

Classified

Special Programs

  

**Job Summary**

**Las Positas College**  
Las Positas College provides an inclusive, learning-centered, equity-focused environment that offers educational opportunities and support for completion of students’ transfer, degree, and career-technical goals while promoting lifelong learning. At Las Positas College we know that equity will be achieved by changing the impacts of structural racism, ableism, homophobia, and systematic poverty on student success and access to higher education, achieved through continuous evaluation and improvement of all services. We believe in a high-quality education focused on learning and an inclusive, culturally-relevant environment that meets the diverse needs of all our students and staff.
  
  
Equity is parity in student educational outcomes; it places belonging for students of color and disproportionately impacted students at center focus. Our prized and emerging equity efforts include Puente, Umoja, ConnectUp, Brother 2 Brother, Sister 2 Sister, Black Student Union, Presidential Task Force on Systemic and Institutionalized Racism, the Presidential Speaker Series, Black Education Association, UndocuAlly Taskforce, curriculum reviews and a linguistic justice curriculum.  
  
Located in Livermore, Las Positas College is becoming an institution that reflects the diversity in California. We are a learning-centered institution focused on excellence and student success, and are fully committed to supporting all Tri-Valley residents in their quest for education and advancement.  
  
**Joining Our College Community**  
We seek equity-minded applicants who demonstrate they understand the benefits diversity brings to an educational community. We look for applicants who:Value and intentionally promote diversity and consciousness of differenceDemonstrate cultural humility and an ongoing desire to improve cultural competenceAre dedicated to addressing issues of social justiceAccept their shared role and responsibility in addressing opportunity and achievement gaps experienced by studentsHave experience and success in closing student equity gaps and engaging in equitable practices, or are knowledgeable and enthusiastic about implementing practices that achieve these goalsActively seek to identify, disrupt, and remove institutional and/or systemic barriers that adversely impact historically marginalized communitiesEmpower the underrepresented and underservedFoster students’ potential to become global citizens and socially responsible leadersBelieve that all people have the right to an education and work environment free from fear, harassment, or discrimination.  
  
The Chabot-Las Positas Community College District is seeking to fill a Program Coordinator – CalWORKs position for Las Positas College in Livermore, California.  
  
**SUMMARY****DESCRIPTION**  
Under direction, oversee and coordinate the day-to-day operations of the CalWORKs program including performing a variety of para-professional, technical, administrative, and complex office support work related to enhancing services for students including CalWORKs, foster youth, and students who are homeless or at-risk of becoming homeless; assume responsibility for program coordination, implementation, outreach, monitoring, tracking, and reporting; establish and monitor program budgets; coordinate with administration, faculty, staff, and community members to enlist support, cooperation, and participation in appropriate activities related to assigned program(s); and serves as a resource and liaison for students including CalWORKs, foster youth, and students who are homeless or at-risk of becoming homeless.  
  
This is a grant/categorically funded position. Continuation of this position is contingent upon available funding on a year to year basis.

  

**Representative Duties**

The following duties are typical for this classification. Incumbents may not perform all of the listed duties and/or may be required to perform additional or different duties from those set forth below to address business needs and changing business practices.  
  
1. Coordinate the daily services and activities of the CalWORKs program and activities related to foster youth and students who are homeless or at-risk of becoming homeless.  
  
2. Develop the CalWORKs program plan and budget; coordinate budget planning activities and monitor expenditures; prepare monthly budget reports and year-end accountability report; serve as a liaison for both internal and external departments and agencies.  
  
3. Develop, recommend, and implement program plans and objectives; coordinate delivery of service to program participants; ensure participation guidelines are followed.  
  
4. Ensure program expenditures are within allocated budgets and program activities comply with program standards, the CalWORKs Program Plan, and compliance requirements; research potential programs/grants for foster youth and students who are homeless or at-risk of becoming homeless.  
  
5. Conduct intake and orientation to incoming students; determine students’ eligibility for the program; conduct needs assessments; refer students to appropriate resources.  
  
6. Coordinate child care component of program including eligibility and expenditure of funds.  
  
7. Maintain records of student program completion and job attainment.  
  
8. Coordinate with staff in designing and implementing recruitment strategies to support program goals and objectives and to strengthen collaboration with other programs.  
  
9. Provide orientation and training to new employees when assigned; assign, schedule, train, and provide work direction to office staff

new_jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

**RECRUITING COORDINATOR**

We're looking for individuals with a knack for attention to detail, organization, and coordination. Our Recruiting Coordinators handle everything from scheduling interviews to tracking candidate data and ensuring that candidates have a lasting positive experience throughout the interview process. The ideal candidate has interest and may have experience working in a fast-paced, startup-like environment while wearing multiple hats to ensure our candidates have a positive experience at every stage of the recruiting process. Availability, flexibility, and adaptability are the keys to success in this role.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Play a crucial role within a fast-paced environment while working to coordinate and manage onsite and virtual candidate interviews
* Schedule candidate interviews and handle any type of candidate logistics promptly and accurately
* Host candidates onsite and create a candidate experience that's warm, human, and memorable
* Represent and facilitate exceptional partnerships with all stakeholders, candidates, hiring managers, and interviewers to drive excellent customer service and consistent, high-quality work
* Drive and participate in process improvement initiatives and other special projects
* Ensure data integrity by updating candidate records in the applicant tracking system, Greenhouse
* Evaluate and recommend recruitment strategies and solutions to make our processes more efficient

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED SKILLS OR QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Excellent organizational, project management, and multitasking abilities
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Previous experience in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to manage multiple on-going projects, be flexible to change, and adapt to shifting priorities
* Team player with a high sense of urgency
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Prior experience in people operations or recruiting functions

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* This role is based at our Palo Alto office and is fully in-office, 5 days per week
* Available to occasionally work overtime, as schedules vary with operational needs; flexibility is key

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**

$80,000 - $100,000 USD

  

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

*SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

new_jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
Premier Global Links LLC is recruiting on behalf of a confidential, fast-growing fintech company using AI-powered automation to modernize enterprise finance workflows. Its technology helps finance teams streamline accounts receivable processes, reduce manual work, and improve collections efficiency.

We are seeking a motivated **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** with strong outbound prospecting skills to engage finance decision-makers, generate qualified sales opportunities, and help build a scalable sales development process.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prospect into mid-market and enterprise companies, targeting CFOs, Controllers, VPs of Finance, and Accounts Receivable leaders.
* Generate new pipeline through cold calling, personalized emails, LinkedIn outreach, and other outbound channels.
* Research target accounts and tailor messaging around accounts receivable challenges, slow collections, high days sales outstanding (DSO), and manual reconciliation.
* Qualify inbound leads based on business needs, timing, decision-making authority, and product fit.
* Schedule qualified discovery meetings and provide Account Executives with clear prospect notes and relevant business context.
* Meet or exceed monthly meeting, pipeline generation, and activity targets.
* Build, test, and improve outbound sequences, talk tracks, and prospecting strategies.
* Maintain accurate activity records, prospect information, and pipeline data in HubSpot.
* Share prospect feedback and market insights with sales, marketing, and product teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* 1–2 years of experience in a quota-carrying SDR or BDR role within B2B SaaS.
* Proven experience with cold calling and outbound prospecting, including generating pipeline through outbound channels.
* A track record of meeting or exceeding sales development targets.
* Strong written and verbal communication, organization, and time-management skills.
* Comfort using CRM systems and prospecting tools to manage outreach and sales activity.
* Curiosity, resilience, coachability, and a proactive approach to learning new products and markets.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in fintech, financial technology, ERP, or finance-related SaaS.
* Familiarity with accounts receivable, accounts payable, accounting, collections, or financial planning workflows.
* Experience with HubSpot, Apollo, Clay, or similar sales prospecting platforms.
* Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup.
* Familiarity with ERP platforms such as NetSuite or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Experience selling to finance and accounting decision-makers.

**Career Growth and Development**

Join an expanding sales team where you can contribute to outbound strategy, refine messaging, and work closely with founders and Account Executives. High-performing SDRs may have opportunities to progress into Account Executive roles through mentorship and internal career development.

**Compensation and Interview Process**

The compensation package includes a $75,000 annual base salary and approximately $30,000 in variable compensation at target performance. Additional incentives may be considered based on the employer's compensation plan.

The interview process is expected to include an initial conversation, a panel interview, and a case study presentation.

Premier Global Links LLC is an equal opportunity recruiting firm. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, skills, and business needs.

**Job Title: Site Logistics Coordinator**

**Location: Manassas VA / Santa Clara CA**

**Duration: 12+ months Contract**

**No of roles: 2**

**Job Description:**

We are Site Logistics Coordinator for a 12-month contract assignment supporting data center logistics operations in Manassas, Virginia. This is an onsite, 40-hour-per-week role, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. The coordinator will support physical and systematic receiving, material movement, storage organization, inventory accuracy, and return-to-stock activities.

**Responsibilities:**

* Receive data center deliveries both physically and systematically, including devices and consumables.
* Ensure delivered materials are secured and stored appropriately at the time of receipt.
* Expedite shipments and perform ad hoc physical material verification through warehouses.
* Maintain and organize storage areas.
* Create physical project pallets.
* Pull, prepare, and coordinate shipment of materials for movement to other sites or warehouses.
* Support and appropriately escalate emergent data center operations, material requests and other urgent matters.
* Perform inventory accuracy activities, including weekly device inventory scans, scheduled cycle counts based on ABC analysis, and discrepancy deep dives at onsite and warehouse locations.
* Perform physical and systematic Return to Stock (RTS) activities, including RTS rack transactions and post-project unused-material returns.

**Qualifications:**

* Ability to work onsite in Manassas, Virginia, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
* Experience supporting logistics, warehouse, inventory, receiving, shipping, or material-control activities in an operational environment is preferred.
* Ability to maintain accurate inventory records and follow physical and systematic material-handling processes.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, communication, and escalation skills.

**Tools and Technologies:**

* Inventory management systems and warehouse transaction processes.
* Inventory scanning tools and cycle-count processes.
* Material receiving, shipment preparation, and Return to Stock (RTS) workflows.

Regards

Mohamed Kalam S

mohameds@clouddestinations.com

Pay: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

* Health insurance

**ABOUT GREYSTAR**

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com.

**JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY**

This role supports and assists the Community Manager in overseeing and managing the financial and operational facets of the community by completing accounting and bookkeeping tasks, preparing monthly close-out and financial reports, processing invoices for payment, collecting rent, fees, and other payments, completing bank deposits, dispositions, and account reconciliations, and using the property management software to record, track, and report on all financial workings of the community.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Property Type:** Stabilized, Garden Style

**Unit Count:** 450

**Schedule:** Sunday to Thursday, 9am to 6pm.

**Requirements:** 3-5 Years

Housing Discount - This position is eligible for 20% housing discount.

Position eligible for incentive-based bonuses.

***The ideal candidate will have property management experience overseeing communities with 400+ residential units. This role is part of a highly collaborative, resident-focused team that values strong communication, accountability, and a positive community culture. The Assistant Community Manager will support daily property operations while helping create a welcoming, service-oriented environment for residents and team members.***

* Completes the daily transactions and tasks related to the financial operation of the community by collecting and posting rent, fees, and other payments, preparing daily bank deposits and reconciling bank accounts, preparing financial reports, and processing invoices and payables.
* Operates the property management software (Yardi/OneSite) and completes transactions by entering all required fields correctly and by completing updates and back-ups to ensure the integrity of the system.
* Reviews resident files and accounting records to determine unpaid and/or late fees owed, communicates with residents regarding outstanding balances, implements procedures for collecting on delinquencies, and enforces the lease to maximize revenue.
* Reviews and submits invoices from vendors, contractors, and service providers for payment by reconciling work performed or products purchased, obtaining community manager approval, coding charges to appropriate Chart of Account codes, and managing communication between the vendor/contractor, accounting, and the client/owner as needed.
* Follows the Company’s established procedures related to evictions by following proper notice requirements, evicting residents, and representing the community as required in court hearings and eviction proceedings.
* Processes resident move-outs by reviewing lease terms and notice requirements, applying appropriate deposit and lease cancellation fees, if applicable, and processing the disposition in accordance with established procedures and legal requirements.
* Promotes resident satisfaction and retention by responding to complaints, questions, and requests in a timely manner, and taking appropriate action to resolve and address service issues.
* Acts as the on-site supervisor in the absence of the community manager by organizing and delegating daily work, coordinating maintenance and make-ready tasks with the maintenance supervisor, and managing the operation of the community in compliance with Company policies, procedures, and business practices.
* Assists in managing the client/owner relationship by meeting with the owners, conducting community tours, providing updates and information about the community’s performance, and responding to owner requests as needed.
* May assist and/or support leasing and marketing efforts by greeting prospective residents, gathering information about the prospect via the Guest Card, showing ready apartments and models, closing and obtaining the lease deposit, and assisting the prospective resident in completing the rental application and credit verification.
* For California Only: The Assistant Community Manager or Leasing Manager must review all completed move in files prior to submission to the Community Manager for review and approval.

* Detail-oriented and self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as a collaborative member of a team.

**Project Coordinator, School Safety, RIS**
===========================================

* DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION

10/27/2026

* Full-time

Location

MANHATTAN

* Exam may be required

Department

Salary range: $75,777.00 – $111,552.00

Save

**Job Description**
-------------------

In order to be considered for this position candidate must be serving permanently in the title, or reachable on the civil service list.
  
  
The Transportation Planning and Management Division (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility and markings, and ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  
  
Research, Implementation, and Safety unit (RIS) is a multi-disciplinary team dedicated to making the streets of New York City safer for all users as part of Vision Zero, a citywide policy striving to eliminate serious injuries and fatalities from traffic crashes. School Safety, a unit within RIS, is responsible for improving safety near K-12 schools throughout New York City. The group redesigns streets next to schools with a goal of reducing child injuries, improving safety and accessibility, and encouraging non-motorized transportation in all five boroughs. School Safety advises NYC agencies and private parties on school siting and various policy and street design issues related to youth safety and school operations. The unit manages all curb regulations and signage next to NYC K-12 schools, including the School Slow Zone program.
  
  
Under the direction of senior staff and with wide latitude for independent judgment, the candidate will be responsible for planning, developing, designing, and implementing Street Improvement Projects (SIPs) to improve safety for all roadway users with a particular emphasis on child safety, in order to advance the goals of the NYC Streets Plan and the Vision Zero Action Plan. This role will involve project management, extensive community outreach, research, data analysis, implementation coordination, and field work.
  
  
The selected candidate will analyze crash and traffic data; create street designs using AutoCAD; coordinate with staff throughout DOT and partner city agencies; perform extensive community outreach to schools, elected officials, Community Boards, inter-and intra-agency members, and other stakeholders; develop and deliver public presentations; and manage implementation of new roadway designs. Outreach work with students in NYC schools may be required on some of the projects. Additionally, the candidate will have the opportunity to investigate new design treatments and policy initiatives, to develop and pilot innovative safety treatments, and to develop new capital projects for implementation by the Department of Design and Construction on behalf of NYC DOT School Safety. The candidate will also coordinate research efforts; participate in technical and advisory committee meetings; and work with DOT staff and external agency representatives on studies and projects.
  
  
Additional tasks may include reviewing community requests as related to school safety and operations in NYC. Furthermore, the candidate will help the team deliver on the ambitious goal of Mayor Mamdani’s administration to install a 15-mile-per-hour school slow zone next to every K-12 school in NYC by the end of 2029 and assist with planning and coordination tasks associated with the School Slow Zone program.
  
  
The Department of Transportation's (DOT) mission is to provide for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods in the City of New York and to maintain and enhance the transportation infrastructure crucial to the economic vitality and quality of life of our primary customers, City residents.
  
  
CITY PLANNER - 22122

  
  

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

  
  

1. A master’s degree from an accredited college or university in city planning, urban planning, urban design, architecture, landscape architecture, transportation engineering, public administration, economic development or a related field; or
  
  
2. A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university and one year of satisfactory full-time experience in city planning such as in the review and
  
development of housing, transportation, environmental, and city-owned land planning projects; or
  
  
3. A satisfactory combination of education and/or experience that is equivalent to "1" above. Graduate education in city planning, urban planning, urban design, architecture, landscape architecture, transportation engineering, public administration, economic development or related fields may be substituted for experience on the basis of 30 graduate semester credits from an accredited college or university for one year of experience. However, all candidates must have a baccalaureate degree.
  
  
4. To be eligible for placement in Assignment Level III, individuals must have, after meeting the minimum requirements, two additional years of professional experience as described in "2" above.

  
  

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

  
Proficient in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, AutoCAD, and Adobe Creative Suite. Knowledge of traffic calming, urban design, pedestrian-oriented design, and complete streets is required. Excellent writing, editing, oral presentation, and community outreach skills are a must. Knowledge of traffic engineering and data analysis, including Synchro and ArcGIS, is preferred. Preference will be given to candidate who possess a driver's license valid in the state of New York with no restrictions. This license must be maintain

new_jobs.description:
The Workplace Experience Program Specialist owns employee events, programs, and experience initiatives end-to-end, from initial brief and stakeholder alignment through planning, production, and post-initiative review, and serves as the primary workplace experience partner to our senior leaders. This role is New York, USA-based.

The Specialist operates independently across a varied portfolio of concurrent work, managing vendors, cross-functional partners, and budgets. Success requires the ability to move fluidly between strategic advisory and hands-on delivery shaping the brief with a department head one day, managing a venue walkthrough the next.

**Key Responsibilities**

Event Planning & Delivery

Own assigned events from end-to-end, from brief through delivery and post-event wrap. The scope, scale, and complexity of what is owned increases with seniority, as does the degree of independent judgement expected at each stage.

* Own end-to-end delivery of employee events, programs, and experience initiatives across the US
* Build project plans, run-of-show documents, and risk plans for complex or large-scale events
* Manage vendor sourcing, negotiations, contracts, and on-site relationships
* Oversee full budget management: forecasting, reconciliation, and reporting
* Coordinate cross-functional support (facilities, IT, People team, etc.) to ensure seamless execution
* Ensure legal and compliance requirements are met across all event-related procurement

Stakeholder Partnership

* Serve as the primary workplace experience partner to department heads and People leadership in the US
* Lead stakeholder briefings and alignment sessions; translate business intent into experience design
* Advise on event strategy: help leadership determine the right format, investment level, and experience goals
* Manage expectations proactively; navigate competing priorities and tight timelines with clarity

Standards & Process

* Apply and uphold our event and experience execution standards; adapt frameworks for the US market context
* Contribute to the development and refinement of global event standards, playbooks, and the service catalog
* Introduce new event formats and experience approaches that raise the bar for employee programming
* Maintain accurate records: post-event documentation, budget actuals, attendance data, and learnings

Data & Continuous Improvement

* Own the US events measurement approach: collect, analyze, and report on experience quality and employee sentiment
* Produce post-event reports and strategic write-ups; link outcomes to broader employee experience goals
* Analyze trends across the US event portfolio to inform future program investment and priorities

Collaboration & Teamwork

* Work closely with the global Workplace Experience team to align the US event portfolio with broader workplace experience strategy
* Partner with the Experience Design team on integrated experiences where events connect to broader business outcomes
* Represent the Workplace Experience function in US-based cross-functional planning forums

**What We're Looking For**

Genuine passion for employee experience, the ability to operate independently across a varied and concurrent portfolio, and the credibility to partner with senior leaders on experience strategy.

* At least 4-6 years of experience, including ownership of large-scale events or employee experience programs
* Proven track record delivering events and programs from concept through completion- on time, on brand, and on budget
* Strategic thinker who can move between vision and execution without losing either
* Strong stakeholder manager: shapes briefs, manages expectations at leadership level, and advocates for the employee experience
* Comfortable developing playbooks, processes, and standards- both for their own work and as contributions to the broader global team
* Deep knowledge of event production: vendor markets, technical production, and logistics
* Self-directed and adaptable; comfortable owning the full delivery chain independently

*There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, roles are eligible to be considered for an annual bonus and equity grant.*

*The range for the NYC-metro area is: $110,291 - $122,545*

**About Agoda**

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

  

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. **Overview**

What began in 2017 as an idea on the back of a napkin has quickly become an award-winning, fastest-growing communications firm working with some big-name consumer and B2B technology brands. At SourceCode, we’re focused on bringing brains and hustle, humanity and technology, creativity and business intelligence back to public relations.

SourceCode’s Account Coordinators are not expected to remain on the sidelines of an account and are encouraged to be active, curious, and collaborative members of the team. We’re looking for a motivated professional with 0–1 years of PR experience (or strong internship background) to become a valued teammate and foundational support for our clients. We want our Account Coordinators to take on real responsibilities and embrace opportunities that help them grow rapidly as professionals. Opportunity here is earned, initiative is rewarded, and success is celebrated across the wider team.

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Draft Client Materials:** Write press releases, media pitches, and client reports, collaborating with senior team members to refine and polish content.
* **Build Media Networks**: Conduct research to build targeted media lists using tools like Muck Rack, support daily outreach, and pitch stories with a goal of converting opportunities 60%–70% of the time.
* **Monitor Coverage & Trends**: Track media coverage and analyze Muck Rack data to identify industry themes and trends for regular client reports.
* **Client Communication**: Liaise with client contacts over Slack, email, and status calls to deliver updates and draft client messages with minimal edits.
* **News Monitoring**: Read and share relevant daily news that connects to client priorities, helping to identify and lead rapid-response media opportunities.
* **Campaign Tracking**: Monitor speaker opportunities, awards, event calendars, and seasonal editorial calendars to maximize client success.
* **Influencer & Social Support**: Research and identify targeted influencers and assist with social calendar management and content creation.
* **Account Logistics**: Deliver accurate meeting agendas, action items, call reports, and recap emails to team leads for review.
* **Project Management**: Coordinate and track account workflows across teams to ensure timely delivery of services.
* **Active Brainstorming**: Bring creative thinking and vocal contributions to internal and client brainstorming and planning sessions.
* **Goal Alignment**: Maintain awareness of client goals and KPIs, proactively alerting team members with recommendations if tasks fall behind schedule.
* **Operational Excellence**: Learn agency processes, maintain accurate time-tracking, and support business health by understanding the impact of under/over-servicing clients.
* **Business Development**: Support agency growth by participating and taking an active role in business development.
* **Skill Growth**: Actively develop your writing skills, stay current on industry trends, and participate in professional development sessions per quarter.

**Hybrid (NYC-based)**

Designed to balance focused remote work with the collaborative energy of our headquarters located conveniently near Penn Station.

* In-Office: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday
* Remote: Monday, Friday

**Salary Range**: $50,000 - $55,000

 **Requirements**

**What You Have:**

* **Agency & PR Fundamentals**: A foundational understanding of how PR agencies operate and a basic familiarity with core industry tools (e.g., Muck Rack).
* **Media & Relationship Savvy**: A strong appreciation for how the media operates, with a demonstrable background in building smart media lists and pitching journalists, influencers, or analysts.
* **Strong Writing & Research Skills**: Ability to research a business or industry and compose a thoughtful, well-crafted position on a relevant topic.
* **Fast-Paced Project Management**: Exceptional organizational and time-management skills, with a meticulous attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple priorities without sacrificing quality.
* **Workload & Boundary Management**: The confidence to clearly communicate your workload to team members, proactively managing and resetting expectations across multiple deadlines when necessary.
* **Creative Problem-Solving**: Curiosity to ask the right questions, a willingness to figure things out, and a passion for pushing beyond "one-size-fits-all" strategies to try new things.
* **Start-Up Mindset:** An ambitious, adaptable, and hard-working attitude with the ability to think on your feet, meet strict deadlines, and actively contribute to a growing team's success.
* **Clear Communication**: Ability to articulate ideas succinctly and draft written materials with a high degree of accuracy.
* **Location**: Currently based in the NYC area, or fully prepared to relocate to NYC by your official start date.

  
**Benefits**

**What We Offer:**

* Robust benefits program
* Unlimited vacation with PTO minimums
* Unlimited sick time
* 401k with company match
* Monthly wellness and mobile stipends
* 2 ‘NOPE’ days/year
* Profit-sharing program
* Workplace flexibility
* Professional learning and development allotment
* 6-month paid parental leave
* Transit benefits
* Paid volunteer and professional development days

**About Wunderkind:**

Wunderkind ads are 'behaviorally triggered', meaning that ads are served on a premium list of publishers only when a user is done consuming content. Our proprietary tag is integrated directly on the publisher page to track on-site user behavior - making '**net new'** ad placements. *How* we serve the ad is why we are different from our competitors in-market.

Rather than placing an ad in front of someone while they're actively trying to read content, our technology patiently waits until a visitor has stopped reading before rendering our ad on the page. And that patience pays off - it turns out that when an ad experience respects the user's reason for visiting a page, the user respects the ad experience in return. This unique, brand safe approach to ad experience gives an advertiser's message more attention and greater engagement.

**About the Role:**

Here at Wunderkind, we have an innovative and truly differentiated enterprise product that fundamentally changes how publishers monetize their websites and you can play a key part in leading that shift.

Wunderkind Ads is looking for a top-performing Account Manager to work with our existing business team to retain and expand agency, trading desk, brand and DSP accounts across the midwest region. **Additional Qualifications:**

* Manage excellent customer service and monitor service request turnaround and responsiveness of maintenance staff.

This position plays an important role in maintaining strong client relationships, ensuring customer satisfaction, and helping customers maximize the value of our IT services. The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, and comfortable managing multiple customer accounts while working closely with internal technical teams to deliver an exceptional client experience.

**Role Overview**

The Customer Success Specialist will be responsible for managing an assigned portfolio of customer accounts, serving as a primary point of contact, and building long-term relationships with key stakeholders. This individual will conduct regular customer meetings and business reviews, monitor account satisfaction, address concerns, and identify opportunities to better support each client's evolving business needs.

This is a customer-facing position that requires strong communication skills, accountability, and the ability to build trust with business owners, executives, and other decision-makers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Account Management & Customer Relationships**

* Manage an assigned portfolio of customer accounts, serving as the primary relationship contact and trusted advisor.
* Develop a strong understanding of each client's business operations, technology needs, goals, and service expectations.
* Conduct regularly scheduled customer meetings and business reviews to discuss service performance, address concerns, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Maintain proactive communication with clients to strengthen relationships, ensure satisfaction, and support long-term retention.
* Travel locally to customer sites as needed for meetings, business reviews, and relationship management.

**Customer Success & Service Coordination**

* Monitor customer satisfaction and proactively identify potential issues or areas requiring additional attention.
* Serve as an escalation point for customer concerns, coordinating with internal technical teams to facilitate timely resolution and clear communication.
* Support the onboarding of new customers by ensuring a smooth transition and helping clients understand available services and support processes.
* Identify opportunities to recommend additional IT services and solutions that align with customer needs and business objectives.

**Internal Collaboration & Account Documentation**

* Collaborate with technical support, sales, and leadership teams to ensure customer needs and expectations are understood and addressed.
* Maintain accurate customer account records, meeting notes, service concerns, and follow-up activities.
* Share customer feedback and insights with leadership to support service improvements and strengthen the overall customer experience.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Previous experience in customer success, account management, client relationship management, or a similar customer-facing role.
* Experience in the IT services, technology, or Managed Service Provider (MSP) industry is strongly preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to confidently interact with business owners, executives, and technical professionals.
* Strong relationship-building and interpersonal skills with a customer-focused approach.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, prioritize responsibilities, and consistently follow through on commitments.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to take ownership of customer concerns and coordinate effective solutions.
* Ability to understand and communicate IT-related concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 and the ability to quickly learn new business systems and software.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel locally to customer sites as needed.

**Critical Competencies**

* **Customer Focus:** Committed to delivering an exceptional customer experience and maintaining long-term relationships.
* **Proactive Mindset:** Anticipates customer needs and takes initiative to address potential concerns.
* **Accountability:** Takes ownership of responsibilities and consistently follows through on commitments.
* **Professionalism:** Demonstrates confidence, sound judgment, and professionalism when interacting with customers and colleagues.
* **Adaptability:** Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing customer needs and priorities.

**Additional Position Requirements**

* Drug- and alcohol-free workplace with pre-employment and random drug testing.

* Flexible spending account

* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
