**About Copado**

Copado is the leading DevOps platform for Salesforce, revolutionizing how the world's largest organizations achieve success in their Salesforce deployments. Our mission is to accelerate the Salesforce development lifecycle, support digital transformation, and deliver unparalleled value to our customers. We continuously innovate, ensuring our platform meets the evolving needs of Salesforce developers and operations professionals.

**About the Role**

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) for Copado Agentia is a highly technical, strategic advisor dedicated to supporting our Success customers. We are looking for AI-first mindset individuals who are passionate about driving AI and platform adoption across customer organizations. Moving beyond the traditional scope of account management, this position requires a strong technical aptitude to provide hands-on, day-to-day guidance and establish DevOps and AI best practices directly with customer engineering and release management teams.

In this role, you will act as a technical partner and a true extension of the customer's delivery team. You will work closely with global cross-functional teams, collaborating creatively to solve complex deployment and pipeline challenges and accelerate AI and platform adoption to deliver seamless customer experiences. You will leverage deep technical expertise in Copado Agentia, including both Metadata and Source Format Pipelines, to optimize release delivery, streamline branching strategies, and drive AI-driven platform workflows. You will own the full account lifecycle, drive tailored success plans, and act as the definitive technical expert to help customers scale their DevOps and AI programs efficiently, reduce release risk, and maximize the value of Copado tools.

**What You’ll Do**

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for Signature Success and Success+ customers, building trusted advisor relationships with release managers, senior developers, and DevOps leads
* Conduct regular Copado Agentia platform health checks, proactively identifying gaps in pipeline configuration, branching strategy, deployment reliability, and metadata management
* Provide hands-on technical guidance on Copado Source Format Pipelines and Metadata Pipelines, including commit, promote, and deploy operations, conflict resolution, and environment variable management
* Guide customers through pipeline design and optimization, covering branching strategies, user story workflows, back-promotion patterns, and multi-environment release governance
* Advise on Salesforce metadata management best practices, including nested metadata handling, destructive changes, profile and permission set deployments, and SFDX source format adoption
* Support customers in configuring and extending Quality Gates and the Quality Integration Framework (QIF), embedding automated quality checks at every stage of the pipeline
* Guide customers through DevOps integrations, connecting Copado pipelines with Git providers, ALM tools such as Jira, and external systems via the Actions API and Webhooks
* Develop and deliver tailored best practice frameworks covering pipeline architecture, deployment task automation (Apex scripts, manual tasks), data deployments, and release scheduling
* Collaborate closely with Copado's internal Support, Engineering, and Product teams to escalate, triage, and resolve complex technical issues, acting as a bridge between the customer and resolution teams
* Own and drive customer success plans, aligning platform capabilities to business objectives and tracking measurable outcomes such as deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and release confidence
* Identify risks to customer health early and proactively engage stakeholders to course-correct before issues impact delivery
* Deliver enablement sessions, workshops, and documentation to upskill customer teams and drive self-sufficiency across Copado Agentia
* Champion an AI-first mindset to accelerate AI and platform adoption across customer release workflows and DevOps teams
* Advocate for customer needs internally, channeling product feedback to influence the Copado Agentia roadmap

**What We’re Looking For**

* Proven expertise in Salesforce DevOps, with a track record of designing, implementing, and scaling robust CI/CD pipelines using Copado Metadata Pipelines and/or Copado Source Format Pipelines
* Strong proficiency in Salesforce metadata management, including SFDX source format, Salesforce CLI operations, and metadata API concepts
* Hands-on experience with Copado Agentia operations: commit, promote, deploy, validation deployments, quick deployments, and deployment task configuration (Apex scripts and manual tasks)
* Solid understanding of Git version control concepts, including branching strategies, merge conflict resolution, and repository management in the context of Salesforce delivery

At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

**Things You’ll Do**

* **Client-Centric & Collaborative:** We work closely with internal product and engineering teams to ensure our clients' voices drive ongoing platform improvements.

Exoticca is a pioneering online travel agency that has revolutionized the conception, production, and e-commerce of long-distance dream trips. At the core of Exoticca's brand equity is the commitment to "creating life milestones." We believe in delivering best-value trips, exploring unique destinations, curating extraordinary travel experiences, and demonstrating genuine care for both our customers and the planet.  
  
We are a professional, dynamic, multicultural team in rapid international growth, seeking new partners to help us create the best and most forward-thinking travel company of our generation.

Our B2B Sales Team is responsible for developing and growing Exoticca's network of Travel Advisors and agency partners across North America. Through a combination of field sales, training, account activation and relationship management, the team helps Travel Advisors discover Exoticca, understand our product and ultimately grow their business with us.

**What will you do?**  
The Sales Representative (B2B) is a field-based sales role focused on developing and growing Exoticca's Tier 2 and Tier 3 agency accounts (Silver & Bronze) within an assigned territory. This is a hands-on, execution-focused position with a strong emphasis on in-person agency visits, account activation and high-frequency market coverage.

You will work closely with the Business Development Managers and the broader B2B Sales Team to ensure that our Silver and Bronze accounts receive regular commercial attention, product education and support, helping them increase their engagement and bookings with Exoticca.

**Your main responsibilities will include:**  

* Visit Travel Agencies regularly across the assigned territory, maintaining a consistent and high-frequency field presence.
* Manage and develop a portfolio primarily composed of Silver and Bronze account (Tier 2 & Tier 3) within Exoticca's Loyalty Program.
* Build strong relationships with Travel Advisors and agency teams, becoming their day-to-day commercial point of contact.
* Activate and grow existing accounts, helping Travel Advisors move from registration to first booking and from occasional to more frequent production.
* Identify opportunities to reactivate dormant and low-producing accounts.
* Educate Travel Advisors on Exoticca's destinations, products, promotions, booking tools and Loyalty Program.
* Conduct in-person product presentations, agency trainings and webinars.
* Identify potential new agency partners and support the acquisition and activation of new accounts.
* Promote group opportunities and identify potential group business within the assigned portfolio.
* Attend relevant trade shows, industry events, conferences and FAM trips when required.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date information on account activity, visits and commercial opportunities in CRM.
* Work closely with Business Development Managers to identify accounts with significant growth potential that may require additional commercial support.
* Meet agreed activity and performance KPIs, including agency visits, account activation, booking activity and portfolio development.

The emphasis on frequent field coverage and a recurring visit pattern is intentional: the Sales Representative role is designed to provide more intensive market coverage than the more senior BDM structure.

 **Requirements**  

* 1–2 years of experience in sales, business development, account management on the travel industry.

The Operations Associate position is responsible for supporting efficient, accurate, and organized operations in our yard facility. This position is responsible for staging material pick ups, completing associated paperwork and making local deliveries among other duties in the yard and office. * Support efficient daily operations in shop and yard facilities

new_jobs.description:
Are you ready to grow your career with a company that values excellence and invests in its people? At Clune Construction, we’re more than builders—we’re a team of driven, collaborative and talented individuals who take pride in delivering exceptional work. Excellence is at the core of everything we do, from the quality of our projects to the way we support our people. As an employee-owned company, we invest in our team, and in return, our people share in our success. This shared commitment has earned us recognition as a Best Place to Work, a US Best Managed Company and a recipient of the Better Business Bureau Torch Award for Ethics.

Whether you’re a seasoned construction professional or looking to bring your expertise to a new area, we welcome you to join our team and make an impact!

  
  
  
**Essential Skills**

* Support business development and preconstruction efforts by coordinating pursuit information, reviewing RFP requirements, assisting with client presentations, organizing project information, and supporting conceptual, schematic, design development, GMP, and lump sum budgeting activities.
* Coordinate preconstruction planning activities by aligning project documentation, logistics planning, constructability reviews, procurement requirements, value engineering efforts, general conditions, and field input to support successful project execution.
* Coordinate subcontractor procurement activities by preparing bid packages, maintaining bidder information, managing proposal collection, clarifying scope requirements, leveling proposals, supporting award recommendations, and tracking subcontract execution.
* Coordinate project startup and execution planning by supporting kickoff meetings, organizing project controls, assisting with schedules, logistics, procurement activities, communication plans, and alignment between project leadership, field teams, and project stakeholders.
* Manage assigned project documentation workflows by coordinating RFIs, submittals, document distribution, project logs, reporting requirements, and follow-up activities to maintain accurate project information.
* Support project financial management activities by coordinating cost tracking, reviewing commitments, assisting with change order documentation, supporting billing workflows, updating CMiC information, and maintaining accurate project financial records.
* Coordinate project communication and stakeholder alignment by preparing meeting agendas, documenting meeting minutes, tracking action items, supporting OAC meetings, coordinating project updates, and maintaining communication among owners, architects, engineers, trade partners, and internal teams.
* Support construction operations and field coordination by working with project managers and field leadership on scheduling activities, procurement tracking, QA/QC requirements, safety coordination, site visits, logistics planning, and issue resolution.
* Coordinate project closeout activities by tracking punch list completion, organizing closeout documentation, coordinating trade partner deliverables, supporting turnover requirements, and assisting with Day Two work.
* Contribute to team development and process improvement by supporting intern involvement, mentorship activities, recruiting efforts, training initiatives, lessons learned, and consistent application of project systems and workflows.

  
**Required For All Jobs**

* Performs other duties as assigned
* Complies with all policies and standards

Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. If you have questions on your job description as outlined, please contact your supervisor or Human Resources.
  

  
  

**What We Offer**  
At Clune Construction we value each of our employees and care about their wellbeing. We strive to provide best-in-class benefits packages, including:

* 100% company-paid premiums for Medical, Dental & Vision for all dependents (effective day one)
* Employee Stock Ownership Plan
* 401k Retirement Plan with Company Match

* Company-paid Short Term and Long Term Disability
* Flexible Spending, Dependent Care and Commuter Plans
* Career Development through Mentoring Program, Learning & Development, Continuing Education

**Core Values and Behaviors**  
Clune Construction is proud to have Core Values and Behaviors that all of our employees represent. These Core Values are: Safety, Service, Teamwork, Respect, Excellence, Leadership and Innovation. Performance is evaluated with these Core Values in mind.
